senses.grammatical_frame: Adjective, comparative masculine singular nominative (ἀλυπότερος) with subjunctive ὦ in a ἵνα purpose clause
senses.definition: Less sorrowful or more relieved of anxiety and grief.

entries.collocations_and_notes: Paired in purpose clause: ἵνα ἰδόντες αὐτὸν πάλιν χαρῆτε κἀγὼ ἀλυπότερος ὦ ('so that seeing him again you may rejoice and I may be less sorrowful').
entries.uncertainty_note: Occurs only once; the comparative ἀλυπότερος paired with χαρῆτε ('you may rejoice') clearly expresses reduction of grief or worry, though one attestation does not show the positive degree's exact range (e.g., 'untroubled' vs. 'painless').

entries.core_meaning_summary: The rising or resurrection from among the dead, spoken of as a goal to attain.

senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, feminine singular accusative after εἰς with verb καταντήσω, qualified by τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν
senses.definition: Resurrection or rising up from the dead.

entries.collocations_and_notes: Occurs in εἴ πως καταντήσω εἰς τὴν ἐξανάστασιν τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν ('if somehow I may attain to the resurrection from the dead').
entries.uncertainty_note: Occurs only once; the modifier τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν ('from the dead') establishes the referent as resurrection, though a single occurrence cannot clarify whether it adds any distinct nuance beyond more common resurrection nouns.

entries.core_meaning_summary: To strain forward or reach out eagerly toward what lies ahead, contrasted with forgetting what is behind.

senses.grammatical_frame: Verb, present middle/passive participle (ἐπεκτεινόμενος) governing dative τοῖς δὲ ἔμπροσθεν, contrasted with τὰ μὲν ὀπίσω ἐπιλανθανόμενος
senses.definition: To stretch forward or strain eagerly toward goals that lie ahead.

entries.collocations_and_notes: Forms a μέν/δέ contrast: τὰ μὲν ὀπίσω ἐπιλανθανόμενος τοῖς δὲ ἔμπροσθεν ἐπεκτεινόμενος ('forgetting what is behind and straining forward to what is ahead').
entries.uncertainty_note: Occurs only once; contrast with τὰ ὀπίσω ἐπιλανθανόμενος and link to οὔπω ... κατειληφέναι clearly indicate intense forward straining, though one occurrence leaves open whether the image is specifically a runner leaning toward the finish or general stretching out.

entries.core_meaning_summary: Deeply longed for or dearly desired, used as an affectionate term of address alongside 'beloved.'

senses.grammatical_frame: Adjective, masculine plural vocative coordinated with ἀγαπητοί in direct address (ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοὶ καὶ ἐπιπόθητοι)
senses.definition: Longed for, missed, or dearly cherished by the speaker.

entries.collocations_and_notes: Grouped with affectionate titles in direct address: ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοὶ καὶ ἐπιπόθητοι, χαρὰ καὶ στέφανός μου.
entries.uncertainty_note: Occurs only once; coordination with ἀγαπητοί ('beloved') and χαρὰ καὶ στέφανός μου ('my joy and crown') marks deep personal affection, though a single instance does not fix the exact balance between 'missed in absence' and 'dearly prized.'

entries.core_meaning_summary: In a different manner or otherwise, describing holding a divergent viewpoint.

senses.grammatical_frame: Adverb modifying the present indicative φρονεῖτε ('you think/are minded') in conditional clause εἴ τι ἑτέρως φρονεῖτε
senses.definition: Differently or otherwise than the viewpoint just stated.

entries.collocations_and_notes: Contrasted with τοῦτο φρονῶμεν ('let us think this'): καὶ εἴ τι ἑτέρως φρονεῖτε, καὶ τοῦτο ὁ Θεὸς ὑμῖν ἀποκαλύψει.
entries.uncertainty_note: Occurs only once; contrast with τοῦτο φρονῶμεν clearly establishes 'differently/otherwise,' while any broader collocational range outside mental attitude (φρονέω) is unattested.

entries.core_meaning_summary: Like-minded or kindred in spirit, sharing the speaker's genuine concern for the community.

senses.grammatical_frame: Adjective, masculine singular accusative; direct object of ἔχω, expanded by relative clause ὅστις γνησίως τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν μεριμνήσει
senses.definition: Kindred in spirit or sharing the same inner concern and outlook as another.

entries.collocations_and_notes: Occurs in οὐδένα γὰρ ἔχω ἰσόψυχον, ὅστις γνησίως τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν μεριμνήσει ('for I have no one like-minded who will genuinely care for your affairs').
entries.uncertainty_note: Occurs only once; the defining relative clause shows it denotes shared inner devotion and concern for others, though one occurrence leaves open whether it stresses equality of temperament, mutual sympathy, or shared loyalty.

entries.core_meaning_summary: Taking place on the eighth day (or eight days old), specifying the timing of circumcision in a list of ancestral credentials.

senses.grammatical_frame: Adjective, masculine singular nominative paired with dative of respect περιτομῇ ('in circumcision') in an autobiographical credential list
senses.definition: Eight-day (circumcised on the eighth day), marking adherence to the prescribed time of infant circumcision.

entries.collocations_and_notes: Opens a list of status markers: περιτομῇ ὀκταήμερος, ἐκ γένους Ἰσραήλ, φυλῆς Βενιαμείν, Ἑβραῖος ἐξ Ἑβραίων, κατὰ νόμον Φαρισαῖος.
entries.uncertainty_note: Occurs only once; pairing with περιτομῇ in an Israelite credential list identifies eighth-day circumcision, though a single attestation leaves open whether the adjective describes the person ('eight days old at circumcision') or the rite's timing ('eighth-day').

entries.core_meaning_summary: To exalt to the highest honor or rank, paired with bestowing the name above every name.

senses.grammatical_frame: Verb, 3rd person singular aorist active indicative (ὑπερύψωσεν) with subject ὁ Θεός and object αὐτόν, coordinated with ἐχαρίσατο
senses.definition: To raise to supreme honor and preeminence.

entries.collocations_and_notes: Coordinated with bestowing supreme status: διὸ καὶ ὁ Θεὸς αὐτὸν ὑπερύψωσεν, καὶ ἐχαρίσατο αὐτῷ τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ὄνομα.
entries.uncertainty_note: Occurs only once; pairing with 'the name above every name' establishes supreme elevation in status/honor, though one instance cannot determine whether it carries a comparative force ('exalt higher than before') or superlative force ('exalt supremely').

entries.core_meaning_summary: Proclitic coordinating and sequential conjunction linking words, phrases, and clauses in additive, sequential, purposive, circumstantial, or contrastive relationships.

senses.definition: Links grammatically equivalent elements within a clause—such as nouns, proper names, numerals, prepositional phrases, direct-object phrases, infinitive phrases, or relative clauses—into a compound or inclusive group.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic conjunction prefixed to the second and subsequent coordinated nouns, numerals, prepositional phrases, or object markers

senses.definition: Joins finite verbs in temporal, logical, instructional, or purposive sequence: in past narrative (typically with doubled prefix consonant or lengthened vowel before first person), in future/habitual/procedural sequences, and in chains of commands or volitional statements where a following verb expresses an ensuing action, purpose, or result.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic conjunction prefixed to finite verbs in narrative, instructional, conditional, or volitive sequences

senses.definition: Introduces a new clause, list item, conditional case, discourse transition, or parallel poetic line, connecting sentences and thematic units across larger stretches of prose and poetry.
senses.grammatical_frame: Clause-initial proclitic conjunction before subjects, adverbials, conditional particles, or parallel poetic clauses

senses.definition: Links a clause that states an accompanying situation, background condition, contrast, or unexpected outcome alongside the main statement.
senses.grammatical_frame: Clause-initial proclitic conjunction before a nominal/participial clause or non-sequential verbal clause

entries.collocations_and_notes: Exhibits conditioned phonological variants in the pointing: most commonly וְ, becoming וּ before labial consonants or initial consonant clusters with vocal shewa (e.g., GEN 46:31; NUM 2:22; 1CH 7:34) and before certain initial syllables (e.g., NEH 7:9; PSA 107:3), וִ before yod with shewa (1CH 25:6) or composite shewa/gutteral patterns (2KI 18:32), וָ in accented word-pairs such as יִרְאָה וָרַעַד (PSA 55:6), וָמֵת / וָחָי (DEU 19:5), and first-person singular narrative sequential verbs (DAN 8:27), and וַ with gemination of the following prefix consonant in third/second/plural narrative sequential verbs (e.g., GEN 18:10; EXO 32:31; 1SA 6:13) as well as before אֲשֶׁר/אֲנִי/אֲרָם (DEU 19:5; EZK 13:22; DAN 8:27; 1CH 7:34). Common fixed pairings include בֵּין ... וּבֵין ('between ... and', EXO 14:2; JOS 22:27), מִן ... וְעַד ('from ... even to', JON 3:5), וְעַתָּה ('and now', 2SA 7:29), וְהִנֵּה ('and behold', GEN 18:10), וְכִי ('and if/when', LEV 11:37), and וְאִם ('and/but if', JDG 13:16).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Independent third-person masculine singular pronoun and bound pronominal suffix series indicating person, number, and gender across nominal, prepositional, and verbal hosts.

senses.definition: Independent third-person masculine singular pronoun functioning as the grammatical subject or emphatic resumptive subject of a nominal or verbal clause.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent 3ms pronoun standing as clause subject or resumptive subject before a predicate

senses.definition: Independent third-person masculine singular pronoun preceded by the definite article, modifying a preceding definite noun to point to a specific, non-immediate referent.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent 3ms pronoun prefixed with ha- following a definite noun in apposition

senses.definition: Bound pronominal suffix attached to a singular or plural noun in the construct state to express possession, kinship, or relational association (attested in this corpus's lemmatization across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd person forms).
senses.grammatical_frame: Pronominal suffix attached to singular or plural nouns

senses.definition: Bound pronominal suffix attached to prepositions or the definite direct-object marker ʾēṯ to indicate the indirect, prepositional, or direct object participant (attested across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd person forms).
senses.grammatical_frame: Pronominal suffix attached to prepositions (e.g., l-, b-, ʾel, ʿal, ʾēṯ/ʿim) or the object marker ʾēṯ

senses.definition: Bound pronominal suffix attached directly to a finite verb or infinitive construct to mark its direct object (attested across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd person forms).
senses.grammatical_frame: Pronominal suffix attached directly to finite verb forms or infinitives construct

entries.collocations_and_notes: In this corpus's lemmatization, both the independent third-person masculine singular pronoun (hûʾ) and bound pronominal suffixes across persons, numbers, and genders are grouped under this headword. Independent hûʾ frequently serves for topic/focus emphasis in nominal clauses (e.g., JOS 23:3) or as a distal demonstrative with the definite article in temporal expressions (bayyôm hahûʾ, 1SA 10:9). Bound suffixes vary morphologically by person, number, gender, and host stem (e.g., -ô / -āyw / -êhû for 3ms, -āh for 3fs, -hem / -ām for 3mp, -ḵā / -ēḵ / -ḵem for 2nd person, -î / -nî / -nû for 1st person).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Proclitic definite article marking specific, known, or contextually identified nouns, substantivized expressions, and their agreeing modifiers.

senses.definition: Prefixed to a common noun to identify a specific, previously introduced, unique, or contextually understood entity, group, place, or material.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic article prefixed directly to singular or plural common nouns

senses.definition: Prefixed to an attributive adjective, ordinal numeral, or demonstrative pronoun to mark agreement in definiteness with a preceding definite or possessed noun.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic article prefixed to post-nominal modifiers agreeing with a definite or suffixed head noun

senses.definition: Prefixed to a participle or adjective to introduce a substantivized agent, group, or concept, or a restrictive descriptive clause referring back to a definite noun.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic article prefixed to participles, adjectives, or numerals used substantively or as relative modifiers

senses.definition: Prefixed to a gentilic or ethnic designation to refer collectively to a people group or specifically to an individual by origin.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic article prefixed to gentilic nouns (singular collective or plural)

senses.definition: Prefixed to the noun 'day' (yôm) in temporal expressions denoting the present day or a particular narrative day.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic article prefixed to yôm in adverbial or clause-initial temporal constructions

entries.collocations_and_notes: Vocalization shifts conditioned by the initial consonant of the host word: typically ha- with doubling of the following consonant (e.g., haššāmayim, hammeleḵ), lengthening to hā- before non-doubling gutturals or rēš (e.g., hāʾāreṣ, hāʿām, hārōʾš), and dissimilating to he- before certain gutturals with qāmeṣ (e.g., hehārîm in JER 4:24 and MIC 1:4; heḥāy in 1KI 3:23). Frequently recurs in fixed phrases such as bayyôm hahûʾ ('on that day', 1SA 14:31, ISA 22:12), bāʿēṯ hahîʾ ('at that time', 2CH 16:7), and in vocative or identificatory apposition (e.g., ʾattâ hāʾēl, 'you are the God', PSA 77:15).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Inseparable preposition marking recipient, beneficiary, possession, purpose or infinitival complement, resultant state, spatial or temporal orientation, and specification.

senses.definition: Marks the recipient, addressee, beneficiary, or affected party of an action or utterance, including reflexive self-reference or personal involvement with verbs of motion and action.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before a personal noun, deity name, or pronominal suffix functioning as indirect object or beneficiary
senses.semantic_domain: Recipient, Beneficiary, and Direction of Action

senses.definition: Expresses ownership, belonging, social or official allegiance, or topical reference ('as for').
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition in verbless/relative clauses of possession (e.g., אֲשֶׁר לוֹ, מַה לִּי וָלָךְ) or clause-initial topic phrases

senses.definition: Indicates purpose, intended goal, or verbal complement, most commonly prefixed to an infinitive construct (including לֵאמֹר to introduce speech and לְבִלְתִּי for negative purpose).
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before an infinitive construct (or negated לְבִלְתִּי) or a noun of goal/task

senses.definition: Marks a resulting state, status, role, or transformation, especially with verbs of being, becoming, or cultic acceptance.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition introducing a predicative complement after verbs such as הָיָה or רָצָה

senses.definition: Marks spatial direction, orientation, or temporal limit, frequently in compound prepositions with body-part or relational nouns ('before', 'in front of', 'to meet', 'apart from', 'beyond').
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before directional nouns, time terms, or relational nouns forming compound prepositions

senses.definition: Marks specification, manner or degree, distributive apportionment/ratio, or the object of verbs of calling or naming.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before measure/quantity nouns, manner idioms (e.g., לְפִי חֶרֶב, לָרֹב), or the complement of קָרָא

entries.collocations_and_notes: Attaches directly as a proclitic prefix (l-, lā-, la-, le-, li-) before nouns, pronouns, and infinitives construct. Extremely frequent with verbs of speaking (e.g., לֵאמֹר introducing direct discourse), giving, and swearing; often forms compound prepositions such as לִפְנֵי ('before / in front of'), לִקְרַאת ('to meet'), and לְבַד מִן ('apart from'). With verbs of motion or personal action, pronominal suffixes (e.g., לְךָ, לִי) often function reflexively or highlight the subject's personal involvement.

entries.core_meaning_summary: Inseparable preposition marking spatial location, temporal setting, means or instrument, attendant circumstance, association, and various verbal complements.

senses.definition: Marks spatial position, containment, surface contact, distribution across an area, or entry into a sphere of control (e.g., into someone's hand).
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before a noun, demonstrative, or pronominal suffix denoting place, region, body part, or sphere of control

senses.definition: Indicates inclusion or presence within a group or company of people.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before a plural noun denoting a group or class of persons

senses.definition: Marks a point in time, a span or season, or a contemporaneous action when prefixed to an infinitive construct.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before a temporal noun, life-stage term, or infinitive construct

senses.definition: Identifies the instrument, means, agentive intermediary, authority, or price by which an action or transaction takes place.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before a noun denoting an instrument, force, intermediary (e.g., hand, word), commodity, or an infinitive construct

senses.definition: Expresses an attendant condition, state, event, or underlying ground or cause.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before an abstract noun or event noun denoting a state, emotion, offense, or situation

senses.definition: Marks the evaluative standpoint in idioms with 'eyes', a partitive object with eating, or the target/complement of verbs such as trusting, looking upon, or executing judgment.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition in construct phrase 'in the eyes of' or as a required verbal complement

entries.collocations_and_notes: Attaches directly as a proclitic prefix to nouns, pronouns, demonstratives, and infinitives construct, often assimilating the definite article vowel (ba-, bā-, be-). Common fixed phrases in the sample include בְּעֵינֵי ('in the eyes of', expressing perspective or evaluation), בְּיַד ('by the hand of' / 'into the hand of', expressing agency, supervision, or control), בְּתוֹךְ ('in the midst of'), and בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא / בָּעֵת הַהִוא ('in that day / at that time'). With infinitives construct, it routinely frames contemporaneous or immediately preceding events.

entries.core_meaning_summary: Functions primarily as the grammatical marker of a definite direct object (and pronominal object carrier), and also as a preposition expressing accompaniment or association ('with').

senses.definition: Unleksicalized grammatical particle marking a definite noun phrase (with article, construct modifier, possessive suffix, or proper name) or relative clause as the direct object of an active transitive verb or infinitive, whether post-verbal or fronted.
senses.grammatical_frame: particle + definite noun phrase or relative clause (ʾăšer) with transitive verb or infinitive

senses.definition: Serves as the pronominal carrier (ʾōṯ-/ʾôṯ-/ʾeṯ- + suffix) expressing a definite pronominal direct object of a transitive verb or infinitive, used post-verbally, fronted for contrast, or resumptively.
senses.grammatical_frame: particle + pronominal suffix with transitive verb or infinitive

senses.definition: Marks the patient/grammatical subject of a passive (Niphal) verb, or introduces a fronted topicalized noun phrase resumed later in the clause by a prepositional pronoun.
senses.grammatical_frame: particle + definite noun phrase with passive verb (Niphal) or fronted topic construction

senses.definition: Preposition indicating spatial presence, companionship, shared participation in a state, or interpersonal addressee/interlocutor (with suffixal base ʾitt- or standalone/proclitic ʾeṯ-).
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition (ʾēṯ / ʾeṯ- / ʾitt-) + noun or pronominal suffix

entries.collocations_and_notes: In this dataset, lemma_id 5408 encompasses both the definite direct object particle (proclitic ʾeṯ-, standalone ʾēṯ, and suffixal base ʾōṯ-/ʾôṯ-/ʾeṯ-) and the homographic preposition of accompaniment (standalone ʾēṯ, proclitic ʾeṯ-, and suffixal base ʾitt-). The object marker commonly introduces coordinated lists (GEN 15:19; JER 25:20), precedes relative clauses with ʾăšer (NUM 23:12; 2SA 19:36), and allows fronting of the object or topic before the verb (JOS 11:12; ISA 22:10; EZK 20:16). When a verb in the passive (Niphal) stem appears with ʾeṯ- (DEU 12:22), it marks the grammatical subject/patient. As a preposition of accompaniment, it pairs with verbs such as 'lie down' (2SA 7:12) and 'speak' (JER 7:22).

entries.core_meaning_summary: A primary preposition indicating spatial departure or origin, separation or avoidance, partitive selection, temporal boundary, cause, or comparison.

senses.definition: Marks the spatial starting point, place of departure, or directional origin from which a person, object, or action proceeds.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun / demonstrative (often after verbs of motion)

senses.definition: Indicates separation, removal, deliverance, withholding, or turning away from a person, group, danger, burden, or moral state.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun (with verbs of removing, rescuing, turning, or separating)

senses.definition: Introduces an action from which someone is restrained, prevented, or turns back.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + infinitive construct

senses.definition: Denotes the personal, bodily, or authoritative source from which speech, descendants, dictation, judgment, or support originates.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun / pronominal suffix

senses.definition: Expresses a partitive relationship, identifying a portion, subset, or individual member drawn from a larger group, substance, or category.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + plural/collective noun or pronominal suffix

senses.definition: Combines with positional or relational prepositions (such as 'under', 'upon', or 'with') to specify relative location or detachment from someone's presence or control.
senses.grammatical_frame: compound preposition (min + taḥaṯ / ʿal / ʿim) + noun or suffix

senses.definition: Marks a temporal point or boundary, indicating either the completion of a time span ('at the end of') or the following day.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + temporal noun (qēṣ / māḥŏrāṯ)

senses.definition: Introduces a cause, threat, or lack that brings about a state or motivates a protective action, especially in compound forms with 'face' or 'without'.
senses.grammatical_frame: compound preposition (mippənê / mibbəlî) + noun or participle

senses.definition: Marks the standard of comparison in an elliptical comparative clause, indicating superiority or greater extent relative to another entity.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + proper noun (in comparative context)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently proclitic with assimilated nun (mi- + gemination, or mē- before gutturals/resh) and takes pronominal suffixes such as mimmennāh and mēhem. Forms common compound expressions with spatial/relational words: mittaḥaṯ lə- ('below'), mēʿal lə- ('above'), mēʿal ('away from / off'), mēʿim ('from with'), mippənê ('because of / against'), mibbəlî ('because of the lack of'), miqqēṣ ('at the end of'), mimmāḥŏrāṯ ('on the next day'). In JOB 5:5 it appears in the unusual combined sequence ʾel miṣṣinnîm ('even out from thorns'). In ISA 10:10 it functions elliptically in a comparison ('[greater] than Jerusalem and Samaria').

entries.core_meaning_summary: The personal proper name of the God of Israel, depicted as creator, covenant speaker, ruler, deliverer, and judge.

senses.definition: Personal name of Israel's deity functioning as the active subject of speaking, commanding, creating, delivering, keeping covenant, and judging.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proper noun as grammatical subject of finite verbs or participles

senses.definition: Personal name of Israel's deity modifying a preceding noun in a construct relationship to indicate divine possession, agency, or association (such as his word, house, spirit, messenger, anger, or ark).
senses.grammatical_frame: Proper noun as genitival absolute in a construct chain

senses.definition: Personal name of Israel's deity used as the object of devotion, sacrifice, fear, vision, or offense, as well as in direct vocative prayer and oath formulas.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proper noun as direct object (with אֶת), prepositional object (לְ / מֵאֵת), vocative, or in oath formula חַי יְהוָה

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired in apposition or construct with titles and descriptions such as יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים (GEN 2:4), יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם (DEU 20:18), יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם (JON 1:9), and יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת (ISA 14:23; ZEC 1:12). Appears regularly in prophetic and narrative introductory formulas (וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל, LEV 23:23; כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה, ISA 66:1; וַיְהִי דְבַר יְהוָה אֶל, JER 32:26; נְאֻם יְהוָה, ISA 14:23) and in the oath formula חַי יְהוָה ('as YHWH lives', 2SA 12:5). In the Masoretic vocalization of the sampled verses, it is usually pointed יְהוָה but occasionally יְהֹוָה (EXO 13:15; DEU 32:9; EZK 46:13).

entries.core_meaning_summary: A primary preposition expressing spatial position above or upon a surface, proximity or orientation, authority over others, direction toward an affected target, causal ground, or addition and obligation.

senses.definition: Denotes physical location above, resting on, or in contact with the upper surface of an object, person, or expanse.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun phrase (spatial location/contact)

senses.definition: Marks spatial proximity alongside, facing before, or covering around an area or structure.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun phrase (proximity/orientation)

senses.definition: Combined with the prefix מִן (מֵעַל), marks separation or removal away from a surface or out of someone's presence.
senses.grammatical_frame: Compound preposition מֵעַל + noun or pronominal suffix

senses.definition: Indicates supervisory authority, royal rule, or administrative charge over people, offices, or property.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun/pronoun (with verbs of ruling or verbless predicate)

senses.definition: Introduces the recipient, target, or affected party of speech, commands, blessings, judgment, hostility, or directed action.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun/pronoun (complement of verbs of motion, speech, command, or hostility)

senses.definition: Marks the cause, basis, reason, or beneficiary motivating an emotion, ritual act, petition, or resulting state.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun phrase or demonstrative כֵּן (causal/benefactive)

senses.definition: Expresses addition alongside another item or a duty, guilt, or obligation resting upon someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun/pronoun (with verbs of adding or verbless obligation clause)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently combines with body-part nouns in spatial or idiomatic phrases such as עַל פְּנֵי ('over/on the face/surface of', GEN 1:2; 'before/facing', 2KI 23:13), עַל פָּנֶיהָ ('on her face', RUT 2:10), עַל רֹאשׁ ('on the head of', GEN 47:31; LEV 4:29), עַל יָד/יָדַיִךְ ('on the hand/hands', JER 40:4; EZK 16:11), and עַל שִׁכְמוֹ ('on his shoulder', ISA 22:22). Forms the compound preposition מֵעַל ('from upon/off from', JOS 23:15; 'away from the presence of', 2SA 13:9) and the causal connector עַל כֵּן ('therefore, on account of this', LAM 3:21). Takes pronominal suffixes on an expanded stem עָלַי-/עָלֶי-/עָלָיו/עֲלֵיהֶם. In JER 23:35 it alternates in direct parallelism with אֶל ('to') as the addressee marker after the verb 'say'. In administrative contexts it frequently appears in verbless clauses marking oversight ('over', 1KI 4:5; 2KI 10:22).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Preposition indicating spatial motion or direction toward a goal, the addressee of speech or communication, mental orientation or hostile directedness, and proximity or association.

senses.definition: Marks the spatial goal, destination, or endpoint of physical movement, gathering, sending, or casting.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun or pronominal suffix, following verbs of motion, sending, bringing, or gathering

senses.definition: Marks the addressee or recipient of spoken words, revelation, messages, or blessings.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + person/group, following verbs of speaking, revealing, or in verbless message/blessing formulas

senses.definition: Marks mental attention, moral heed, empowering descent, or directed action (often adverse) aimed at a person, command, or place.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun or pronominal suffix, following verbs of attention, listening, rushing (of spirit), bringing calamity, or setting the face

senses.definition: Indicates spatial proximity or static association/possession in relation to a person or group.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun or pronominal suffix, modifying a stative verb (הָיָה) or adjective of nearness (קָרוֹב)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Takes pronominal suffixes on an expanded stem אֵלַי-/אֵלֶי-/אֲלֵי- (e.g., אֵלַי, אֵלֶיךָ, אֵלָיו, אֵלֶיהָ, אֲלֵיכֶם, אֲלֵיהֶם). Most frequently collocates with verbs of speaking (אָמַר, דִּבֶּר) to mark the addressee, and with verbs of motion (בּוֹא, הָלַךְ, שׁוּב, יָצָא, שָׁלַח, קָבַץ, טוּל) to mark the destination. In formulas of greeting or commission (e.g., JDG 3:19, PSA 129:8), it marks the intended recipient without an explicit verb of motion. Occasionally overlaps with adverse or hostile orientation ('upon, against') with verbs of bringing judgment or setting one's face (JER 35:17, EZK 4:3).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Indeclinable relative particle and subordinating conjunction introducing relative clauses modifying a noun or pronoun, headless relative clauses, and adverbial or explanatory clauses of manner, time, or fact.

senses.definition: Relative marker introducing a dependent clause—either verbal or verbless with a prepositional predicate—that modifies or restricts an explicit nominal, pronominal, or personal antecedent.
senses.grammatical_frame: relative particle following an explicit noun, proper name, or pronoun antecedent, introducing a verbal or verbless clause

senses.definition: Independent relative marker introducing a headless clause functioning as a nominal constituent (subject or direct object), frequently preceded by כֹּל ('all').
senses.grammatical_frame: relative particle without an explicit noun antecedent, often after כֹּל, serving as subject or object of a matrix verb

senses.definition: Subordinating conjunction introducing clauses of manner, time, explanation, or event, especially in compounds with prepositions such as כְּ ('just as', 'when') and עַד ('until').
senses.grammatical_frame: subordinating conjunction (bare or compounded with prepositions כְּ or עַד) introducing an adverbial or factive clause

entries.collocations_and_notes: Extremely frequent subordinating particle that is indeclinable across gender and number. Frequently prefixed with prepositions to form compound conjunctions, most commonly כַּאֲשֶׁר ('just as, according as' in LEV 8:9, DEU 2:22, 1KI 21:11, JER 39:12; temporally 'when' in JDG 3:18) and עַד אֲשֶׁר ('until' in JOS 1:15). Headless relative clauses frequently combine with כֹּל ('all that', e.g., GEN 34:29, 1SA 14:7, 1SA 30:19, 2KI 14:28). A resumptive pronoun may appear inside the relative clause when the antecedent is an object or indirect constituent (e.g., NUM 10:29). In verbless relative clauses, it regularly links a noun directly to a locative prepositional phrase (e.g., GEN 1:7, DEU 16:11, JOS 13:9, EZR 1:3, EST 3:2, ISA 37:2, EZK 40:44).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Quantifier indicating the totality, entirety, or every individual instance of an entity, group, or domain.

senses.definition: Indicates the full extent or total membership of a specified group, region, period, or single entity without exception.
senses.grammatical_frame: Quantifier noun in construct before a definite plural, collective, or singular noun phrase

senses.definition: Indicates each individual member, case, or item belonging to a class without restriction.
senses.grammatical_frame: Quantifier noun in construct before an indefinite singular noun

senses.definition: Substantival quantifier referring to the entirety of a previously mentioned or specified set, either before a demonstrative or relative clause or carrying a pronominal suffix.
senses.grammatical_frame: Quantifier noun in construct before a demonstrative pronoun or relative אֲשֶׁר, or bearing a pronominal suffix

senses.definition: Refers broadly to everything as a whole or every respect in an absolute prepositional phrase.
senses.grammatical_frame: Absolute noun preceded by the preposition בְּ (בַּכֹּל)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Predominantly occurs in the construct state (כָּל־, כֹּל) proclitic to a following noun, demonstrative, or relative particle, or with pronominal suffixes (כֻּלָּם in ISA 57:13; כֻּלָּהּ in AMO 9:5). Common fixed temporal and spatial expressions include כָּל־הַיָּמִים ("all the days / continually", DEU 28:33) and תַּחַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם ("under the whole sky", JOB 28:24). In negated clauses with גַּם אֶחָד ("not even one", 2SA 17:12), בְּכָל denotes any member of the group. In JDG 16:17, כְּכָל־הָאָדָם ("like all mankind") denotes ordinary people generally.

entries.core_meaning_summary: To utter words, state, command, think, or be spoken of, typically introducing direct speech or expressing an internal thought or directive.

senses.definition: To produce spoken words in communication, whether making a statement, answering, asking, or pronouncing a prophetic message, usually followed directly by the quoted words.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active basic stem (Qal), finite or participial, alone or with אֶל / לְ + addressee, followed by direct speech

senses.definition: To introduce the quoted words of a preceding verb of speaking, telling, calling, or sending a message, functioning as a quotative marker.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active basic stem (Qal), infinitive construct with prefixed לְ (לֵאמֹר) following another verb of communication or sending

senses.definition: To issue an order, give a directive, or state a binding promise or intention regarding an action to be carried out.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active basic stem (Qal), with אֲשֶׁר + imperfect, with לְ + infinitive construct, with an imperative quote, or absolute before resulting action

senses.definition: To hold or express an inner conviction, claim, or resolve within oneself, often equivalent to thinking or supposing.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active basic stem (Qal), introducing an assertion or inner resolve (including negated prohibition with אַל)

senses.definition: To be spoken of, designated, or addressed by a descriptive name or characterization.
senses.grammatical_frame: Passive stem (Niphal), imperfect + לְ + addressee/referent + predicate designation

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently introduces direct discourse with the addressee marked by the prepositions אֶל (ʾel) or לְ (lĕ), or without an explicit addressee. Commonly appears in the prophetic messenger formula כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה (JER 14:15; JER 28:11; JER 38:3; EZK 21:8; AMO 1:11; ZEC 1:17), in the revelation formula וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר (EZK 6:1; EZK 35:1), and in dialogue sequences with wayyiqtol forms (JDG 17:9; 2SA 1:3; 1KI 18:43; 2KI 2:2). The infinitive construct לֵאמֹר is grammaticalized as a speech-introducing particle after verbs such as דִּבֶּר (LEV 10:3; NUM 27:8), שָׁלַח (JOS 10:6; 2SA 13:7), הִגִּיד (2SA 19:9), and קָרָא (ZEC 1:17). Contrastive parallel with חָשַׁב (JOB 35:2) and יִקָּרֵא (ISA 62:4).

entries.core_meaning_summary: The primary negative adverb used to negate verbs, clauses, prohibitions, non-verbal constituents, and negative questions or oaths.

senses.definition: Negates an action, event, state, or capability expressed by a finite verb across past, present, future, or general assertions, as well as in subordinate causal, relative, conditional, or negative-purpose clauses.
senses.grammatical_frame: Negative adverb immediately preceding a finite verb (perfect or imperfect)

senses.definition: Expresses a binding, categorical, or lasting prohibition when paired with an imperfect verb.
senses.grammatical_frame: Negative adverb preceding an imperfect verb in legal, ritual, or instructional discourse

senses.definition: Negates a specific non-verbal phrase, adjective, participle, noun, or prepositional phrase, including the combination בְּלֹא indicating absence ('without').
senses.grammatical_frame: Negative adverb preceding a noun, adjective, participle, or prepositional phrase (or following בְּ)

senses.definition: Functions in rhetorical negative questions expecting an affirmative response, or within אִם ... לֹא constructions to frame a solemn oath, pledge, or judicial denial.
senses.grammatical_frame: Combined with interrogative הֲ (הֲלֹא / הַ... לֹא) or conditional אִם (אִם לֹא)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Commonly precedes finite verbs directly; combines with prepositions (e.g., בְּלֹא 'without'), interrogative הֲ (הֲלֹא expecting an affirmative answer), and conditional אִם (אִם לֹא in conditional clauses or solemn oaths). In legal and prophetic instructions with an imperfect verb, it expresses enduring prohibition.

entries.core_meaning_summary: A male child or descendant, extended to tribal or ancestral members, members of a human group, guild, or locality, young animals, and expressions of age.

senses.definition: A direct male offspring of human parents; used in patronymics to identify a person by their father, and in the plural sometimes encompassing children borne by a mother generally.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, masculine singular or plural; absolute, with possessive suffixes, or construct before a parent's name

senses.definition: A male or collective descendant traced through earlier generations, or a member of a tribe, clan, or ancestral family named after an ancestor or ancestress.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, singular in multi-generational chains or construct plural (בְּנֵי) before an eponymous ancestor or clan name

senses.definition: An individual standing in a covenantal or adoptive father-son relationship of loyalty, authority, and protection, used of a king in relation to God.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, masculine singular after preposition לְ in parallel with אָב ('father')

senses.definition: A member or representative of a broader category, such as humankind, a professional or religious guild, or the inhabitants of a city or nation.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, construct singular or plural before a generic noun (אָדָם), occupational group, or place name

senses.definition: The young offspring of an animal species, specifically young cattle.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, construct singular or plural before an animal collective noun (בָּקָר)

senses.definition: A person characterized as having lived a specified number of years, forming the standard idiom for stating age.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, construct singular before a numeral and שָׁנִים ('years')

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently occurs in construct forms (בֶּן־ / בְּנֵי־) to mark patronymic lineage (e.g., X בֶּן־Y), tribal or clan identity (בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, בְּנֵי דָן), human classification (בֶּן־אָדָם / בְּנֵי הָאָדָם), vocational or social guilds (בְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים, בְּנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים), animal youth (בְּנֵי בָקָר), and age expressions (בֶּן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים). Also appears paired with בַּת ('daughter') or אָב ('father') in kinship and inheritance contexts.

entries.core_meaning_summary: A multi-purpose subordinating and coordinating conjunction that introduces causal explanations, clausal complements of perception or speech, temporal or conditional circumstances, and contrastive or exceptive qualifications.

senses.definition: Introduces a clause providing the reason, basis, ground, or motivation for a preceding statement, command, warning, or praise.
senses.grammatical_frame: Subordinating conjunction introducing a causal or explanatory finite clause

senses.definition: Introduces a direct or indirect content clause serving as the object or explanation of verbs of seeing, knowing, hearing, or proclaiming.
senses.grammatical_frame: Complementizer following verbs of perception, cognition, or speech (`רָאָה`, `יָדַע`, `שָׁמַע`, `קָרָא`) + finite clause

senses.definition: Introduces a temporal or conditional circumstance under which an action occurs, a point up to which something continues (`עַד כִּי`), or a consequence following a rhetorical question.
senses.grammatical_frame: Subordinating conjunction introducing a temporal or conditional protasis (often after `וַיְהִי` / `וְהָיָה` or after `עַד`)

senses.definition: Expresses contrast, restriction, exception, or scalar comparison in combination with preceding particles or negatives, including `לֹא ... כִּי` ("no, rather"), `כִּי אִם` ("unless / except"), `אֶפֶס כִּי` ("however"), and `אַף כִּי` ("how much less / more").
senses.grammatical_frame: Adversative or compound particle following a negation (`לֹא`, `אִם`) or paired with `אִם`, `אֶפֶס`, or `אַף`

entries.collocations_and_notes: Combines in several fixed multi-word expressions observed in the packet: `עַד כִּי` ("until"), `כִּי אִם` ("except / unless" after a negative oath), `לֹא ... כִּי` ("no, rather"), `אֶפֶס כִּי` ("however / yet"), and `אַף כִּי` ("how much less / more"). Frequently introduces object clauses after `רָאָה` ("see"), `יָדַע` ("know"), and `שָׁמַע` ("hear"), or temporal clauses after `וַיְהִי` / `וְהָיָה`.

entries.core_meaning_summary: To exist, be in a state or condition, come into being, become something, or mark the unfolding of an event in narrative or future discourse.

senses.definition: To exist, be present, arise, or take place as an entity, event, or message, frequently negated with `לֹא` or `אַל` to express absence or non-occurrence, or paired with `אֶל` when a divine word comes to a prophet.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal); intransitive with subject noun, often with locative phrase or `אֶל` + recipient

senses.definition: To hold a quality, condition, identity, likeness, or measured quantity, linking a subject to a nominal, adjectival, construct, or comparative predicate.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal); copular verb + subject + predicate noun, adjective, numeral, or `כְּ` simile phrase

senses.definition: To transition into a new status, function, or role, or to serve as something for someone, typically marking the resulting status or role with the preposition `לְ`.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal), finite or infinitive construct + `לְ` + predicate noun (sometimes also with `לְ` + person)

senses.definition: To stand in a spatial, relational, or possessive connection with someone or a place, including belonging to someone (`לְ`), accompanying or supporting (`עִם`), resting upon (`עַל`), or staying in a location (`שָׁם`).
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal), finite or infinitive construct + prepositional phrase (`לְ`, `עִם`, `עַל`) or locative adverb + duration

senses.definition: To function as a temporal or discourse-opening marker at the start of a clause, introducing a circumstance, timeframe, or subsequent event in past narrative (`וַיְהִי`) or future announcement (`וְהָיָה`).
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal) 3rd masculine singular consecutive (`וַיְהִי` / `וְהָיָה`) + temporal phrase, `כְּ` + infinitive, or following clause

entries.collocations_and_notes: Only basic active (Qal) finite, volitive, consecutive, and infinitive forms appear in the sampled verses; no derived stems occur in this packet. Frequently forms fixed relational or discourse patterns: `הָיָה לְ` (possession or becoming/serving as), `הָיָה עִם` (accompaniment/support), `הָיָה עַל` (a spirit coming upon someone), `הָיָה דְבַר יהוה אֶל` (a prophetic word coming to someone), and clause-initial `וַיְהִי` / `וְהָיָה` marking narrative transitions or future events.

entries.core_meaning_summary: A proclitic preposition and conjunction-forming prefix expressing similarity or comparison ('like, as'), conformity to a norm or standard ('according to'), or temporal coincidence ('when, as soon as').

senses.definition: Marks an entity, quality, demonstrative, or verbal event as the standard of resemblance or simile for another entity or action.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic prefix attached to nouns, demonstratives (כָּזֹאת, כָּאֵלֶּה), or an infinitive construct (ISA 64:1) introducing a comparison

senses.definition: Indicates conformity, correspondence, or measure relative to a command, pattern, precedent, or standard.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic prefix on nouns of rule/pattern (e.g., מִצְוָה, מַעֲשֶׂה, דְּמוּת, כֹּל, פִּי) or forming the conjunction כַּאֲשֶׁר ('just as / according as'), often paired with כֵּן ('so')

senses.definition: Marks the point in time or immediate circumstance at which an action occurs, or compares a situation to an earlier period of time; with מְעַט it denotes brief temporal proximity.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic prefix attached to an infinitive construct, to אֲשֶׁר (כַּאֲשֶׁר + finite verb), to time nouns (יוֹם, יָמִים), or to מְעַט (כִּמְעַט)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Attaches directly as a proclitic prefix to nouns, demonstratives (כָּזֹאת, כָּאֵלֶּה), infinitives construct, and the relative word אֲשֶׁר (forming the conjunction כַּאֲשֶׁר). Frequently paired in correlative constructions with כֵּן ('just as ... so', JOS 10:1; JOL 2:4). Specialized collocations include כְּפִי ('according to the command/word of', 1CH 12:24) and כִּמְעַט ('scarcely / just after', SNG 3:4). Notice that כְּ with an infinitive construct expresses either temporal sequence ('when / as soon as', JOS 10:1; 1SA 24:17; 2SA 17:9; NEH 9:28) or vivid comparison ('like when', ISA 64:1).

entries.core_meaning_summary: To make, fashion, perform, carry out, or act toward someone or something across physical fabrication, moral/legal conduct, interpersonal treatment, ritual preparation, and productivity.

senses.definition: Create, construct, or craft physical objects, structures, cultic furnishings, or the heavens and the earth, sometimes specifying both the object and the material or pattern in a double-object construction.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active (Qal) stem; transitive with direct object (frequently marked by אֵת), occasionally taking a second object indicating material or form

senses.definition: Perform, carry out, practice, or commit actions, tasks, commands, statutes, or moral/immoral deeds, or act decisively without an expressed object.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active (Qal) stem; transitive with task, command, or deed as object, or intransitive/absolute (e.g., 'take action'); frequently preceded by שָׁמַר ('keep/observe') or modified by כְּ / כַּאֲשֶׁר ('according to')

senses.definition: Act toward, treat, or deal with a person or group, whether by showing loyalty and kindness, intervening to protect from harm, or executing justice, judgment, and disaster.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active (Qal) stem; with recipient marked by לְ ('to/for'), עִם ('with'), בְּ ('against/upon'), or direct object marker אֵת/אוֹת-, often alongside an abstract noun such as חֶסֶד ('loyalty'), מִשְׁפָּט ('justice'), or רָעָה ('harm')

senses.definition: Prepare and offer a sacrificial animal or observe and celebrate an appointed religious festival.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active (Qal) stem; transitive with sacrificial animal or festival (חַג) as direct object

senses.definition: Produce agricultural yield or acquire and accumulate livestock and property.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active (Qal) stem; transitive with produce (קֶמַח) or possessions (מִקְנֶה וְקִנְיָן) as direct object, or absolute

senses.definition: Perform miraculous signs before witnesses, or appoint and establish human leaders to carry out a divine deliverance.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active (Qal) stem; transitive with direct object (אֶת + personal name or הָאֹתוֹת)

entries.collocations_and_notes: All 40 sampled occurrences appear in the basic active (Qal) stem; no passive, intensive, or causative stems appear in this evidence packet. Frequent collocations include כַּאֲשֶׁר ... כֵּן ('just as ... so did', EXO 12:50; NUM 8:20; JDG 8:8; JER 50:15), שָׁמַר לַעֲשׂוֹת ('be careful to carry out', DEU 17:10; DEU 32:46), עָשָׂה חֶסֶד עִם ('show loyalty/kindness toward', GEN 20:13; 2SA 3:8; JOB 10:12), הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ ('what is good in your eyes', 2SA 19:39; 2KI 10:5), עָשָׂה מִשְׁפָּט / שְׁפָטִים ('execute justice/judgments', 1KI 8:49; EZK 16:41), and מַעֲשֵׂה ('workmanship of', EXO 26:1; EXO 39:15). Note also the protective idiom עָשָׂה מֵרָעָה ('act to keep from harm', 1CH 4:10).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Deity: predominantly the one supreme God and creator worshipped by Israel, and also used of a deity in personal/national relationship, other/foreign deities, or adjudicating authorities in a legal dispute.

senses.definition: The supreme creator and sovereign deity, often with the definite article or as subject of singular verbs and in direct prayer address.
senses.grammatical_frame: Absolute noun (with or without definite article) governing singular verbs and pronouns, or vocative

senses.definition: The deity worshipped by, allied with, or belonging to a specific people, ancestor, or individual, frequently standing in apposition to the divine name YHWH or in construct chains.
senses.grammatical_frame: Construct state or with possessive pronominal suffix, often in apposition to YHWH

senses.definition: Deities other than Israel's God, either as a plural group of foreign/rival deities or as the patron deity of a foreign ruler.
senses.grammatical_frame: Modified by plural adjective/pronoun (e.g., ʾăḥērîm, lāhem) or construct with foreign ruler's suffix

senses.definition: The adjudicating authority before whom disputed property and theft cases are brought for a binding verdict, whether human judicial officials or divine judgment.
senses.grammatical_frame: With definite article or bare noun as subject of a plural verb in a legal procedure

entries.collocations_and_notes: Grammatically plural in form, but when referring to the supreme God of Israel it regularly governs singular verbs and pronouns and stands in apposition to the divine name YHWH (e.g., YHWH ʾĕlōhê yiśrāʾēl, YHWH ʾĕlōhê ṣəbāʾôt, YHWH ʾĕlōhêkā). Frequently appears in construct phrases such as bêt hāʾĕlōhîm ('house of God'), ʾărôn hāʾĕlōhîm ('ark of God'), and the prophetic title ʾîš hāʾĕlōhîm ('man of God'). When modified by plural adjectives or pronouns (ʾĕlōhîm ʾăḥērîm, lāhem), it designates plural foreign deities. In EXO 22:8 it takes a plural verb (yaršîʿun) in a legal adjudication context, leaving open whether the text envisions human judges/magistrates acting as legal authorities or a divine tribunal.

entries.core_meaning_summary: In the simple active stem, to move toward and arrive at a place, person, or state, or to enter into a space, relationship, or time; in the causative stem, to cause someone or something to come, i.e., to bring or usher in.

senses.definition: To move through space toward a person or destination and arrive there; used both of reaching a goal and of traveling toward one.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal), intransitive with directional accusative, ʾel, ʿad, min, or adverbial location

senses.definition: To pass into a bounded physical space, territory, or collective event/commitment such as a house, city, sea, temple courts, battle, or covenant.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) with bə-, ʾel, lə-, or direct location noun

senses.definition: To go in to a partner for sexual relations, or to enter a ruler's private quarters for a royal audience/union.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) with ʾel + person (woman or king)

senses.definition: Of the sun, to sink below the horizon at the close of day.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) infinitive construct with subject haššemeš ('the sun')

senses.definition: Of time periods, impending events, or hardships (such as days, disaster, distress, or military attack), to arrive, occur, or come upon someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) with inanimate or abstract subject, often with ʿal ('upon') or participle formula hinnēh yāmîm bāʾîm

senses.definition: To cause a person, animal, or object to come to a place or recipient; to lead, transport, or present something such as offerings, tribute, captives, or provisions.
senses.grammatical_frame: Causative stem (Hiphil), transitive with direct object and optional ʾel or accusative goal

senses.definition: To cause an abstract condition or moral reality (such as enduring righteousness) to arrive or take effect.
senses.grammatical_frame: Causative stem (Hiphil), transitive with abstract noun object

entries.collocations_and_notes: Commonly takes directional prepositions such as ʾel ('to, into'), bə- ('into'), lə- ('to'), ʿad ('as far as'), min ('from'), and accusative destination nouns (including directional -āh endings like bəʾērāh šābaʿ and taršîšāh). Frequently paired with šûb ('return'), hālak ('walk/go'), qābaṣ ('gather'), and yāraš ('possess'). Notable idiomatic patterns include bôʾ haššemeš ('the going down of the sun', i.e., sunset), yāmîm bāʾîm ('days are coming', prophetic future formula), bôʾ ʾel ('go in to' a woman in sexual/marital union or into a king's presence), and bôʾ babbərît ('enter into the covenant'). In the simple active stem it denotes self-initiated arrival or entry; in the causative stem it denotes bringing or leading someone or something to a goal or causing an abstract condition to arrive.

entries.core_meaning_summary: Masculine noun denoting a sovereign monarch ruling over a city, people, or kingdom, and by extension applied to God as Israel's royal sovereign.

senses.definition: A male sovereign ruler holding supreme political, judicial, and military authority over a city-state, people, nation, or empire.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun, singular (מֶלֶךְ) or plural (מְלָכִים / מַלְכֵי), definite or indefinite, frequently in construct before a territory, city, or people, in apposition to a personal name, or governed by לְ to mark royal office ('as king')

senses.definition: A royal sovereign title or concept applied in poetic parallelism to Israel's God as the king present among the people and greeted with royal acclamation.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine singular indefinite noun (מֶלֶךְ) serving as nomen rectum in construct (תְּרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ) in parallel with יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו ('YHWH his God')

entries.collocations_and_notes: Appears both with the definite article alone (הַמֶּלֶךְ 'the king') and in apposition before or after a personal name (הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה, 1KI 10:16; פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם, 1KI 3:1). Frequently heads construct chains specifying the ruled realm, city, or people (e.g., מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל, 1KI 22:4; מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל, JER 21:4; מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר, ISA 36:18; מַלְכֵי אָרֶץ, EZK 27:33), and once links via לְ to a city (מֶלֶךְ לָעִיר סְפַרְוָיִם, 2KI 19:13). Polite courtly address uses אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ ('my lord the king', 1SA 26:19; 2SA 14:22; 1KI 1:20; 1CH 21:23). Related institutional phrases include בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ ('the king's house/palace', 2CH 9:11), בֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ ('the king's son', 2SA 18:20), כִּסֵּא הַמֶּלֶךְ ('the throne of the king', 1KI 1:20), and דְּבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְדָתוֹ ('the king's decree and his law', EST 9:1). In NUM 23:21, the poetic parallel between יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ and וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ associates kingship and royal acclamation with Israel's God.

entries.core_meaning_summary: Feminine noun denoting the physical earth or world as a whole, a specific country or territory, the inhabitants of the earth, or the ground underfoot.

senses.definition: The physical world or terrestrial realm as a whole, often contrasted with the sky or heavens as a part of creation, a recipient of weather, or a cosmic witness.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine singular noun, usually definite (הָאָרֶץ), paired with הַשָּׁמַיִם ('the heavens') or functioning as subject/object of cosmic or meteorological verbs

senses.definition: By metonymy, the human population living upon the earth or within a domain, summoned to worship or characterized collectively.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine singular noun, typically in the phrase כָּל הָאָרֶץ ('all the earth') with plural or collective verbal agreement, or as nomen rectum in construct chains (e.g., עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ, רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ)

senses.definition: A bounded geographical region, country, or homeland belonging to a nation, tribe, or deity, or marked by a particular physical or social quality; plural denotes multiple foreign nations or territories.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine noun, singular or plural (אֲרָצוֹת), frequently in construct with a proper name or descriptive noun, modified by an adjective, or taking a possessive suffix (אַרְצְכֶם), often following spatial prepositions (בְּ, מִן, אֶל)

senses.definition: The physical surface of the earth, soil, or ground upon which people walk, animals run, liquids are poured, plants grow, or toward which one bows or looks down.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine singular noun, with prepositions (עַל, אֶל), in construct (עֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ, אֲפִיקֵי הָאָרֶץ), or with the directional ending -āh (אָרְצָה / אַרְצָה) indicating downward motion

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired with הַשָּׁמַיִם ('the heavens') to denote the entirety of the cosmos (GEN 1:1; DEU 4:26; HAB 3:3). In the sense of a specific territory, commonly appears in construct chains with ethnic or geographic names (e.g., אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם 'land of Egypt', EXO 10:15; אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן 'land of Canaan', NUM 33:51; אֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה 'land of Judah', 2CH 17:2) or descriptive attributes (e.g., אֶרֶץ נָכְרִיָּה 'foreign land', EXO 2:22; אֶרֶץ תַּלְאֻבוֹת 'land of drought', HOS 13:5). With the directional ending -āh (אָרְצָה / אַרְצָה), it functions adverbially to indicate downward motion 'to the ground' in prostration (GEN 43:26; JOS 7:6). When preceded by כָּל ('all') and referring to people (כָּל הָאָרֶץ), it can take plural verbal agreement (PSA 66:4). Plural אֲרָצוֹת refers to multiple distinct nations or regions (JER 16:15; EZK 20:6; EZK 39:27).

entries.core_meaning_summary: The period of daylight, a 24-hour calendar day, the present day ('today'), an appointed occasion, or in the plural a span of time, era, or lifetime.

senses.definition: The sunlit period of daylight as opposed to night or darkness.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine singular noun, contrasted with לַיְלָה ('night') or bounded from אוֹר ('dawn/light') to מַחֲצִית הַיּוֹם ('midday')

senses.definition: A full 24-hour calendar day or counted unit of days in sequences, dates, and durations.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun (singular or plural), modified by cardinal or ordinal numerals, or in construct with an infinitive or date expression

senses.definition: The present day on which an utterance or action takes place.
senses.grammatical_frame: Adverbial definite singular הַיּוֹם or prepositional phrase בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה

senses.definition: A particular occasion, decisive moment, or appointed time of action, distress, or judgment.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular with demonstrative (בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא, הַיּוֹם הַהוּא) or in construct/comparison with qualitative nouns (e.g., רָעָה, עֶבְרָה, מָר) or infinitives

senses.definition: An extended span of time, historical period, ruler's reign, or the course of a person's life.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine plural (יָמִים / יְמֵי / יָמִין), absolute, with demonstrative (בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם), with possessive suffixes, or in construct with personal names and life stages

entries.collocations_and_notes: Plural is normally יָמִים (construct יְמֵי), with one instance of the ending -în in הַיָּמִין (DAN 12:13). Frequently contrasted with לַיְלָה ('night', GEN 1:5) and paralleled with עֵת ('time', JER 30:7; EZK 7:12). Very common fixed temporal expressions include הַיּוֹם ('today', DEU 4:26; 2SA 19:36), בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא ('on that day', 2SA 2:17; ISA 3:18; ZEP 3:11), בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם ('in those days', 2KI 20:1; EST 2:21), and בִּימֵי + personal name ('in the days/reign of', GEN 14:1; JER 1:2). Lifespan idioms include הֶאֱרִיךְ יָמִים ('prolong days', EXO 20:12; DEU 4:26) and comparing days to a shadow or breath (1CH 29:15; JOB 7:16).

entries.core_meaning_summary: An adult male human being, individual person, or husband; extended to characterized roles, collective fighting bodies, and distributive reference ('each one').

senses.definition: An adult male human being, explicitly contrasted with women or children.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun (singular or plural), paired or contrasted with אִשָּׁה ('woman') or טַף ('children')

senses.definition: An individual human being or unspecified person in narrative, legal, or wisdom contexts; with negation, 'no one' or 'anyone'.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun (singular or plural), definite, indefinite, or negated with לֹא

senses.definition: A married man in relation to his wife; a husband.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine singular noun, typically with feminine pronominal suffix (אִישָׁהּ) or contrasted with אִשְׁתּוֹ ('his wife')

senses.definition: A person or group of people defined by occupation, character, locality, or allegiance to a leader or community (such as soldiers, prophets, allies, or inhabitants).
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular or plural construct (אִישׁ / אַנְשֵׁי + noun) or plural with pronominal suffix (אֲנָשָׁיו / אַנְשֵׁיהֶם)

senses.definition: A collective body of men, troops, or counted individuals treated as a grammatical singular or unit counter after numerals.
senses.grammatical_frame: Collective singular in construct with tribal/national names (taking singular verbs) or following cardinal numerals

senses.definition: Each individual within a plural group acting or receiving separately.
senses.grammatical_frame: Distributive singular (אִישׁ / לְאִישׁ) in apposition to or paired with a plural subject or verb

entries.collocations_and_notes: Forms an irregular plural stem אֲנָשִׁים (construct אַנְשֵׁי, suffixed אֲנָשָׁיו / אַנְשֵׁיהֶם) alongside singular אִישׁ (suffixed אִישָׁהּ). Frequently paired with אִשָּׁה ('woman / wife') for gender contrast or marriage (GEN 2:23; JDG 9:49; JER 3:1). Common construct phrases include אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה / אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה ('warriors / fighting men', DEU 2:14; 1SA 18:5; 2SA 17:8), אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים ('man of God', 2KI 4:9), and אַנְשֵׁי בְרִיתֶךָ / אַנְשֵׁי שְׁלֹמֶךָ ('allies / trusted associates', OBA 1:7). With negation לֹא, expresses 'no one / anyone' (GEN 41:44). When singular אִישׁ is in construct with a tribal or national name (e.g., אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל, אִישׁ בִּנְיָמִן), it functions as a collective taking singular verbs (JDG 20:41). Also used distributively as 'each one', sometimes paired with אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחוֹתָהּ (EZK 1:23).

entries.core_meaning_summary: The physical face or countenance, the outward surface or front side of an object or area, and, in prepositional compounds, location before, presence with, priority in time, or cause.

senses.definition: The front part of a human or animal head, facial expression/countenance, or anthropomorphically the face of God; used in idioms for showing favor (lifting the face) or withholding favor/attention (hiding the face).
senses.grammatical_frame: Plural-form noun (פָּנִים) with pronominal suffixes or as object/prepositional complement (e.g., עַל פָּנָיו, נֶגֶד פְּנֵיהֶם)

senses.definition: The outer upper surface of water or land, the front/facing side of an object or territory, or figuratively the outward aspect or direction of an affair.
senses.grammatical_frame: Construct noun (פְּנֵי) governed by spatial prepositions (עַל, אֶל, אֶל מוּל) or as direct object

senses.definition: Spatial or relational position in front of, ahead of, or in the presence, sight, or judgment of someone or something (with לִפְנֵי), or departure/avoidance away from someone's presence or threat (with מִפְּנֵי / מִלִּפְנֵי).
senses.grammatical_frame: Compound preposition (לִפְנֵי, מִפְּנֵי, מִלִּפְנֵי) + noun or pronominal suffix

senses.definition: Prior occurrence or order in time (with לִפְנֵי), or cause/reason on account of which an action or emotion happens (with מִפְּנֵי).
senses.grammatical_frame: Compound preposition (לִפְנֵי temporal; מִפְּנֵי causal) + noun, event, or pronominal suffix

entries.collocations_and_notes: Always appears with plural morphology (פָּנִים, construct פְּנֵי) even when referring to a single face or surface. Very frequently compounded with prepositions (לִפְנֵי, מִפְּנֵי, מִלִּפְנֵי, עַל פְּנֵי, אֶל פְּנֵי) to serve spatial, relational, temporal, and causal prepositional functions. Notable idioms include נָשָׂא פָנִים ('lift up someone's face', i.e., show favor or grant a request, 1SA 25:35) and הִסְתִּיר פָּנִים ('hide one's face', i.e., withdraw attention or favor, PSA 51:11, EZK 39:24).

entries.core_meaning_summary: To transfer, grant, or hand over something or someone to a recipient, as well as to place or set in a location, exchange for something else, or render into a state.

senses.definition: To transfer possession of goods, land, money, food, a person (e.g., in marriage or service), or an abstract benefit/deliverance to a recipient; in passive stems, to be granted or assigned to someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active basic stem (Qal) + direct object + recipient (with לְ or אֶל); also passive simple stem (Niphal) and passive participle with לְ

senses.definition: To trade, convert, or offer one thing in return for or in place of another.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active basic stem (Qal) + בְּ (marking medium/price) or תַּחַת (marking substitution)

senses.definition: To surrender, entrust, or place a person, group, or military force under another's authority, custody, or power; in passive forms, to be surrendered or handed over.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active basic stem (Qal), passive imperfect, or passive simple stem (Niphal) + direct object/subject + בְּיַד ('into the hand of') or אֶל

senses.definition: To put, set, fasten, or apply an object, substance, lot, or consequence in or upon a location; figuratively with אֶל לֵב, to apply one's mind to or take to heart.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active basic stem (Qal) + direct object + locative preposition (בְּ, אֶל, עַל)

senses.definition: To cause a person, land, or structure to become a specified state or condition (such as ruin or an object of scorn).
senses.grammatical_frame: Active basic stem (Qal) + direct object + predicate complement (with לְ or second accusative)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Almost always occurs in the active basic stem (Qal), with occasional passive forms (passive participle in NUM 3:9, passive simple stem / Niphal in 1SA 18:19 and DAN 11:11, and passive imperfect in 2SA 21:6). Frequent idiomatic collocations include: נָתַן בְּיַד ('deliver/entrust into the hand/control of', JDG 6:1, 1CH 19:11, DAN 11:11); נָתַן אֶל לֵב ('take to heart / consider', ECC 7:2); נָתַן לְאִשָּׁה ('give as a wife', 1SA 18:19); נָתַן גּוֹרָלוֹת ('cast lots', LEV 16:8); and נָתַן + object + לְ or double accusative ('turn/make into', 2CH 7:20, JER 12:10, EZK 35:3). Note also the use of בְּ to mark the medium or price of exchange (DEU 14:25, EZK 27:19).

entries.core_meaning_summary: A collective noun denoting a nation, ethnic or covenant community, the general populace of a land, or a gathered company or troop of people.

senses.definition: A distinct nation, ethnic group, or covenant community viewed as a collective whole, used both of Israel and (especially in the plural) of foreign nations.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine singular collective noun (often with plural עַמִּים); frequently with possessive suffixes or in construct with geographic/ethnic terms

senses.definition: The general populace, citizenry, subjects of a ruler, or local community (including lay inhabitants in contrast to religious officials, or one's kinfolk).
senses.grammatical_frame: Usually definite הָעָם, or construct עַם הָאָרֶץ, or with possessive suffix; takes singular or plural verb agreement

senses.definition: A specific body of people, troop, company, or throng assembled for battle, travel, or a ceremonial procession.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular collective noun modified by adjectives, relative clauses (e.g., אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ), or fractions (חֲצִי הָעָם), often taking plural verb/participle agreement

entries.collocations_and_notes: Grammatically masculine singular (e.g., `עַם אֶחָד` in GEN 11:6, `עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא` in DEU 9:13), yet as a collective noun it frequently governs plural verbs and participles (e.g., `וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ` in EXO 12:27, `יֹאמְרוּ` in 1SA 8:7, `הֹלְכִים` in 2SA 13:34, `נִאֲצוּ` in PSA 74:18). Often paired or paralleled with `גּוֹיִם` ("nations") in poetry and prophecy (2SA 22:44, ISA 25:7, EZK 25:7). Common construct phrases include `עַם הָאָרֶץ` ("the people of the land" / general citizenry, 2KI 23:35, JER 52:6) and `כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ` ("all the peoples of the earth", DEU 28:10). Frequently takes 1st-person pronominal suffixes (`עַמִּי`, "my people") to denote Israel in covenant relation with YHWH (EXO 5:1, ISA 5:13) or royal subjects (1CH 28:2).

entries.core_meaning_summary: An unstressed enclitic suffix attached to nouns, adverbs, particles, imperatives, and first-person prefix verbs to indicate spatial direction or location, or to add volitional emphasis and stylistic extension.

senses.definition: Attached to common nouns, proper place names, and compass terms to mark motion toward, spatial orientation, or location at a point or surface.
senses.grammatical_frame: Unstressed suffix (-āh) on common nouns, geographic names, and directional nouns

senses.definition: Attached to spatial adverbs and prepositions to express directional motion, relative position, or upward extension in age or space.
senses.grammatical_frame: Suffix (-āh) on spatial adverbs and prepositions (e.g., מַעְלָה, שָׁמָּה, חוּצָה, נֶגְדָה)

senses.definition: Attached to masculine singular imperatives and first-person singular waw-consecutive prefix verbs to express urgency, solemn appeal, or heightened narrative expression.
senses.grammatical_frame: Suffix (-āh) on masculine singular imperatives and 1st-person singular waw-consecutive prefix verbs

senses.definition: Attached to form the fixed exclamatory expression חָלִילָה ("far be it"), expressing strong rejection or abhorrence of an action.
senses.grammatical_frame: Fixed suffix on exclamatory particle חָלִילָה + לְ + pronominal suffix

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently attached unstressed to nouns and place names to mark destination or compass orientation, as in the four-direction formula in DEU 3:27 and boundary descriptions in JOS 15:11 and EZK 48:4. On adverbs (`מַעְלָה`, `שָׁמָּה`, `חוּצָה`) and prepositions (`נֶגְדָה`), it forms fixed spatial/directional expressions (`מִלְּמַעְלָה` in GEN 6:16, EZK 1:22; `וָמָעְלָה` "and upward" in age counts EXO 30:14, NUM 1:40). On imperatives and `נֶגְדָה`, it co-occurs with the enclitic particle `נָּא` (GEN 38:16, PSA 116:18). On 1st-person singular `waw`-consecutive prefix verbs (`וָאֶקְרָאֶה`, `וָאֶקְבְּצָה`, `וָאֶתְּנָה`, `וָאֶשְׁקֲלָה`), it appears especially in narrative prayers and first-person memoirs.

entries.core_meaning_summary: Denotes spoken or written language, a message or divine proclamation, a reply, an affair or event, and an appointed daily requirement.

senses.definition: An articulated utterance, statement, saying, or expression; in the plural, spoken discourse, vocabulary, or written text such as laws, songs, or prophetic scrolls.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular or plural noun functioning as subject, direct object (e.g., of דִּבֶּר, שָׁמַע, כָּתַב, הִגִּיד), or in construct before a speaker or text (e.g., דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה)

senses.definition: An authoritative message, royal or divine decree, prophetic revelation, or spoken promise intended to be heard, obeyed, or fulfilled.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun, most often in construct (דְּבַר יְהוָה) or with a pronominal suffix, serving as subject of הָיָה/יָצָא or object of מִלֵּא/שָׁמַע/בִּין

senses.definition: A verbal response, report, or answer returned to an inquirer, characteristically with the Hiphil of שׁוּב ("cause to return").
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun serving as direct object of Hiphil הֵשִׁיב ("bring back word to")

senses.definition: An action, deed, occurrence, situation, legal cause, or matter of concern; in the plural construct דִּבְרֵי, historical deeds or annals of a king or period, and with כָּל in negative clauses, "anything."
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular or plural noun serving as subject of נִהְיָה/הָיָה, object of עָשָׂה/כִּחֵד, or in construct phrases (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים, דְּבַר הַתֹּעֵבָה)

senses.definition: The fixed quota, task, or appointed obligation assigned to a particular day.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular construct in the adverbial idiom (לִ)דְבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ

entries.collocations_and_notes: Common collocations include דְּבַר יְהוָה ("the word/message of YHWH," often with הָיָה or שִׁמְעוּ), הֵשִׁיב דָּבָר ("to bring back word / reply"), סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים ("book of the affairs/annals of the days"), and דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ ("the daily requirement / each day's allotted portion"). Frequently takes the demonstrative הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה to refer back to a preceding speech, proposal, or event, and with כָּל in negated contexts (לֹא ... לְכָל דָּבָר) expresses total exclusion ("for anything / in any respect").

entries.core_meaning_summary: Marks an endpoint, boundary, or limit in space, time, or degree, and in fixed nominal expressions denotes unending time.

senses.definition: Indicates the spatial limit, destination, or boundary reached by movement, sight, territory, or a written section, often paired with מִן ("from") or used with spatial adverbs such as פֹּה and הֵנָּה.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition governing a place name, spatial noun, or spatial adverb; frequently paired with מִן ... וְעַד

senses.definition: Marks the temporal limit or endpoint up to which a state or action continues, the duration of a period, or in questions with מָתַי the length of time before a change occurs.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition governing a temporal noun, infinitive construct (with or without pronominal suffix), or the interrogative adverb מָתַי

senses.definition: Introduces a subordinate temporal clause marking the point at which an action takes place or, when negated with לֹא, the time prior to an impending state.
senses.grammatical_frame: Compound conjunction (עַד אֲשֶׁר, עַד שֶׁ, or עַד אֲשֶׁר לֹא) followed by a finite verb clause

senses.definition: Expresses extremity of degree, intensity, or inclusive coverage of every member within a category, including "not even one" in negated clauses with אֶחָד.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition governing a noun of extremity (מָוֶת), adverb of degree (מְאֹד), numeral (אֶחָד), or the upper end of a paired/inclusive list

senses.definition: Denotes unending or perpetual duration when used nominally after the preposition לְ or in the doubled phrase עֲדֵי עַד.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun in prepositional phrases (לָעַד) or construct-like poetic combination (עֲדֵי עַד)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired with מִן ("from") to mark both ends of a spatial, temporal, or inclusive range (e.g., מִן הַבֹּקֶר עַד הָעָרֶב in EXO 18:13; לְמִדָּן וְעַד בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע in JDG 20:1; מִקָּטֹן וְעַד גָּדוֹל in 1SA 5:9; מֵהֹדּוּ וְעַד כּוּשׁ in EST 8:9; מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד מְבֹאוֹ in PSA 50:1). Common fixed combinations include עַד מְאֹד ("exceedingly"), עַד מָתַי ("until when? / how long?"), עַד אֶחָד ("even one" in negative clauses), עַד הֵנָּה ("up to this point"), עַד פֹּה ("this far"), לָעַד and עֲדֵי עַד ("forever / for all time"). Takes the poetic construct-like plural form עֲדֵי in ISA 26:4. Before finite verbs it combines with אֲשֶׁר (or שֶׁ in PSA 123:2), and with אֲשֶׁר לֹא in ECC 12:1 to express "before".

entries.core_meaning_summary: To perceive with the eyes, examine, recognize mentally, or experience; in the passive/reflexive stem to be visible or appear before someone, and in the causative stem to cause someone to see or show.

senses.definition: To perceive physically with the eyes, catch sight of, watch, gaze at, meet face-to-face (`רָאָה פְּנֵי`), or behold a prophetic vision (often introduced with `וְהִנֵּה`).
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal), transitive with direct object, with `מִן`/`בְּ`, or absolute (with `וְהִנֵּה`)

senses.definition: To inspect or examine carefully (such as a skin condition or a land), or to take attentive, compassionate notice of a person's plight or actions.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal), transitive with object or absolute, often with `פְּקַח עֵינֶיךָ` or `וְהִנֵּה`

senses.definition: To perceive mentally, realize, recognize, witness firsthand, or observe and evaluate a fact or outcome.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal), taking a `כִּי` or `אֲשֶׁר` complement clause or an event/deed as direct object

senses.definition: To experience, enjoy, or undergo a condition or fate (such as good, affliction, or the pit/death).
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal), transitive with abstract noun object (`טוֹבָה`, `עֳנִי`, `שָׁחַת`)

senses.definition: In the active stem with `בְּ` and `לְ`, to select or provide someone for a role; as a passive participle, to be deemed suitable or fitting.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal) with `בְּ` + indirect `לְ` + object; or Qal passive participle (`רְאֻיוֹת`)

senses.definition: Substantival participle denoting a prophetic figure who receives divine insight and delivers messages from God.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem (Qal) participle used as a noun with definite article (`הָרֹאֶה`)

senses.definition: In the passive/reflexive stem, to be visible or seen; with `פְּנֵי` or `אֶת פְּנֵי`, to appear or present oneself before the LORD.
senses.grammatical_frame: Passive/reflexive stem (Niphal), intransitive or with `פְּנֵי` / `אֶת פְּנֵי`

senses.definition: In the causative stem, to cause someone to see something, specifically to show a prophetic vision.
senses.grammatical_frame: Causative stem (Hiphil) with personal object suffix + `וְהִנֵּה`

entries.collocations_and_notes: The basic active stem (Qal) covers physical sight, careful inspection, mental recognition, experiencing a condition, and selecting/providing. Its passive participle (`רָאוּי`) means 'fitting/suitable' (EST 2:9), and its active participle substantivized (`הָרֹאֶה`) designates a prophetic 'seer' (2CH 16:7). The passive/reflexive stem (Niphal) means 'be seen, be visible' (1KI 8:8) or, specifically with `פְּנֵי` / `אֶת פְּנֵי`, 'appear/present oneself before' the deity (EXO 34:23, ISA 1:12). The causative stem (Hiphil) means 'cause to see, show' (JER 24:1).
