Common collocations include `רָאָה` + `וְהִנֵּה` introducing a vivid sight or vision, `רָאָה` + `כִּי` introducing a realized fact, and `רָאָה פְנֵי` ('see the face of', i.e., meet or have an audience with).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Masculine singular proximal demonstrative indicating a specific entity, person, time, place, or statement near to the speaker or discourse context, and also serving in spatial, temporal, and emphatic interrogative constructions.

senses.definition: Used attributively after a definite masculine singular noun (or noun phrase) with the definite article, or following `אֲשֶׁר כְּ-`, to single out a specific person, object, matter, place, or day as immediate in context.
senses.grammatical_frame: Attributive demonstrative with definite article following definite masculine singular noun (`הַ-... הַזֶּה`), or with prefixed preposition after relative particle (`אֲשֶׁר כָּזֶה`)

senses.definition: Used independently as the subject, predicate, or object of a clause to identify an entity, introduce or summarize an account or enumeration, or contrast two items in a correlative pair.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent demonstrative pronoun (subject or predicate of nominal/verbal clause, including correlative `זֶה ... זֶה` and pre-nominal `זֶה עָנִי`)

senses.definition: Used adverbially with prepositions `מִן` or `בְּ` to indicate the immediate place or side, or placed before a time noun to measure elapsed duration up to the present.
glosses: on this side ... on that side
senses.grammatical_frame: Prepositional spatial adverbial (`מִזֶּה`, `בָּזֶה`) or temporal modifier preceding a noun of time (`זֶה יָמִים רַבִּים`)

senses.definition: Placed immediately after an interrogative particle to add emphasis, surprise, urgency, or focused specification to a question.
senses.grammatical_frame: Enclitic intensifier following an interrogative (`מַה זֶּה`, `לָמָּה זֶּה`, `אֵי זֶה`)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Very frequently occurs attributively with the definite article after a definite noun (`הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה`, 'this day / today'; `עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה`, 'until this day'; `הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה`, 'this matter/word'; `הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה`, 'this place'; `הָעָם הַזֶּה`, 'this people'). Takes prefixed prepositions such as `בָּזֶה` ('here'), `מִזֶּה` ('from here / on this side'), and `כָּזֶה` ('like this / such as this'). Occurs in correlative pairs (`זֶה ... וְזֶה`, `מִזֶּה ... מִזֶּה`) to contrast two entities or opposite sides. When placed immediately after interrogatives (`מַה זֶּה`, `לָמָּה זֶּה`, `אֵי זֶה`), it adds emphasis or urgency. Note that feminine and plural demonstrative forms are separate lemmas; in this sample `זֶה` consistently functions as the masculine singular/unmarked form.

entries.core_meaning_summary: To perceive sound, hear news, listen attentively and obey, or answer a plea, with passive ('be heard') and causative ('proclaim') usages across stems.

senses.definition: To perceive a sound or voice by ear, or to pay auditory attention when summoned to listen.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active (Qal), with direct object (sound/voice) or absolute in calls to attention

senses.definition: To receive news, a report, or information about an event or person; to learn of something.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active (Qal), with direct object, כִּי ('that') clause, מִן ('from'), אֶל ('about'), or absolute

senses.definition: To listen attentively to instruction, counsel, or command and comply with or obey it.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active (Qal), with בְּקוֹל ('the voice of'), לְ ('to'), אֶל ('to'), direct object ('word'), or absolute

senses.definition: To hear favorably, take note of, and respond to a prayer, plea, or complaint, especially of God toward petitioners.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active (Qal), with direct object of prayer/supplication/complaint or absolute

senses.definition: To be audible or heard, whether of physical tools, a faint whisper, or spoken blessing and prayer.
senses.grammatical_frame: Passive (Niphal), with grammatical subject or בְּקוֹל ('in/with voice')

senses.definition: To cause someone to hear something; to proclaim, announce, or declare publicly.
senses.grammatical_frame: Causative (Hiphil), with direct object or double object (recipient and message)

entries.collocations_and_notes: In the simple active stem (Qal), obedience and compliance are commonly marked with בְּקוֹל / בְקֹל ('the voice of', GEN 27:13, JOS 22:2), אֶל ('to', DEU 18:14, JER 27:17, JER 35:16, DAN 9:6), or לְ ('to', LEV 26:21, PRO 12:15). Frequently parallels verbs of attentive listening such as הֶאֱזִין ('give ear', PSA 54:4, ISA 1:2, ISA 42:23), הִקְשִׁיב ('pay attention', ISA 34:1, ISA 42:23), and הִטָּה אֹזֶן ('incline the ear', JER 11:8). Often paired with עָשָׂה ('to do') to express hearing followed by action (DEU 5:27, DEU 30:12, JER 11:8), and with רָאָה ('to see', LAM 1:18). In the passive stem (Niphal), occurs with בְּקוֹלָם ('their voice was heard', 2CH 30:27).

entries.core_meaning_summary: To speak, utter words, address someone, or declare authoritatively, with simple active, intensive/declarative active, and reciprocal conferring usages across stems.

senses.definition: To utter words, converse, or address someone orally, often introducing direct speech or indicating the content, manner, or language of speech.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active (Piel), absolute or with אֶל ('to'), אֵת ('with'), לְ ('to'), בְּאָזְנֵי ('in the hearing of'), or direct object of speech content

senses.definition: To speak silently within oneself or formulate unspoken thoughts in one's mind.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active (Piel) + אֶל לֵב ('to the heart')

senses.definition: To issue an authoritative command, decree, prophetic pronouncement, or binding promise, especially by God, a prophet, or a ruler.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active (Piel), with אֶל ('to'), עַל ('concerning'), direct object of decrees/words, or absolute in formulaic pronouncements

senses.definition: To speak or express oneself in a specified moral or truthful manner.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active (Qal participle) + adverbial/object modifier

senses.definition: To confer together or talk in opposition against someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Reciprocal/middle (Niphal) + בְּ ('against')

entries.collocations_and_notes: In the active stem (Piel), frequently introduces direct discourse with the preposition אֶל ('to') marking the addressee followed by לֵאמֹר ('saying') (e.g., GEN 8:15, EXO 6:10, LEV 7:22, NUM 1:48, DEU 20:5). Also constructs with אֵת ('with', EXO 31:18, JER 38:25), עַל ('concerning', 1CH 17:17), בְּאָזְנֵי ('in the ears of', 1SA 25:24), and אֶל לִבִּי ('to my heart', GEN 24:45). Often pairs with the noun דָּבָר ('word/matter') in expressions like הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר (JOS 14:6, 1SA 3:17, 2SA 14:15, JER 29:23), and occurs in the divine confirmation formula כִּי פִי יְהוָה דִּבֵּר ('for the mouth of YHWH has spoken', ISA 1:20, ISA 40:5). Frequently paired with אָמַר ('to say') and עָשָׂה ('to act/carry out', e.g., 1KI 2:38, EZK 24:14).

entries.core_meaning_summary: A permanent, typically fortified settlement or town, and by extension its civic body or inhabitants.

senses.definition: A permanent, built-up settlement—ranging from a regional town to a fortified stronghold or major capital—typically enclosed with walls and gates and distinguished from surrounding open villages or pasturelands.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine noun; used absolutely, with adjectives/demonstratives, in construct with regions, rulers, or functions, and as an unmarked directional accusative

senses.definition: The civic community or population of a city or town, whether referred to collectively by metonymy or through officials and members associated with it.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine noun; subject of human actions or states ('was quiet', 'dwell'), or governing noun/genitive in construct with civic offices and residents ('elders of the city', 'men of the city', 'governor of the city')

entries.collocations_and_notes: Feminine noun with irregular plural עָרִים (construct עָרֵי). Frequently appears in construct chains specifying role or possession (e.g., עָרֵי מִקְלָט 'cities of refuge', עָרֵי הָרֶכֶב 'chariot cities', עִיר דָּוִיד 'City of David', שַׂר הָעִיר 'governor of the city', שַׁעַר הָעִיר 'gate of the city'). Often paired or contrasted with surrounding open 'villages' (חֲצֵרִים) or 'pasturelands' (מִגְרָשִׁים), and with 'fortified' (בְּצֻרוֹת) as an epithet. Exhibits distributive repetition (עִיר עִיר 'each city') and singular use with numbers above ten (e.g., שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה עִיר 'thirteen cities').

entries.core_meaning_summary: To sit down or take a seat, remain in place, dwell or settle in a location, and in the causative stem to settle people or repopulate cities.

senses.definition: To take or occupy a seated posture, such as sitting down before someone, sitting in an assembly, or sitting stationed at a gate or landmark.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem; intransitive with prepositional phrases of location ('between', 'before', 'beside', 'in a seat') or participle in construct with a place ('at the gate')

senses.definition: To sit upon a royal throne as ruler, or to occupy a seat of divine dwelling and sovereignty.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem; participle with 'upon his throne', or infinitive construct denoting a royal or heavenly dwelling seat

senses.definition: To stay, wait, or remain temporarily in a place, with someone, or in a particular state over a period of time.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem; intransitive with locative adverbs ('here'), prepositional phrases ('in one's place', 'with'), or phrases of temporal duration

senses.definition: To live, reside, or settle permanently in a territory, city, or household; the participle frequently functions as a noun meaning 'inhabitant(s)' or 'resident(s)'.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem; intransitive with locative prepositions ('in', 'upon', 'among', 'with'), or participle used substantively (absolute or in construct with a place name)

senses.definition: Of a city or land, to be inhabited, remain populated, or continue to stand as a settled place rather than lying desolate.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem; intransitive with a city or personified place as subject

senses.definition: To cause people to dwell or settle in a place, or to make desolate cities inhabited again.
senses.grammatical_frame: Causative stem; transitive with direct object (person or city) and optional locative prepositional phrase

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently pairs with prepositions indicating location or company: בְּ ('in'), עַל ('upon'), אֵצֶל ('beside'), בֵּין ('between'), לִפְנֵי ('before'), בְּקֶרֶב ('in the midst of'), עִם / אֶת ('with'), and adverbial לָבֶטַח ('securely'). The participle in construct (יֹשְׁבֵי, 'inhabitants of') is a regular designation for the population of a city or land, and יֹשְׁבֵי שָׁעַר ('those who sit at the gate') denotes people gathered at the city gate. Often contrasts with 'going out' (יָצָא) when expressing remaining in place. In the causative stem, it governs both the people settled and the cities repopulated.

entries.core_meaning_summary: To go or come out from a place, condition, or source, and (in the causative stem) to bring, lead, or produce outward.

senses.definition: To exit, depart, or move outward from an enclosed space, city, land, or someone's presence; to come out to meet or pursue someone; in the imperative, to get out or leave.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal (basic active stem), intransitive with מִן, מֵעִם, מִתּוֹךְ, אֶל, לִקְרַאת, אַחֲרֵי, or directional -הָ

senses.definition: To march out on a military campaign, enter battle, or serve as an active soldier or leader before the troops.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal (basic active stem), intransitive with צָבָא, לַמִּלְחָמָה, לִפְנֵי, בְּקֶרֶב, or לְ + destination

senses.definition: To flow or discharge from the body; to sprout or emerge from an object; of a cast lot, to come out or fall to someone; or of abstract qualities such as justice, to proceed from someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal (basic active stem), intransitive with מִן or לְ, with non-human or abstract subject

senses.definition: To cause people or objects to move out of a place; to bring out, lead out, carry away, or deliver someone from confinement or distress into safety.
senses.grammatical_frame: Hiphil (causative stem), transitive with אֶת or object suffix, often with מִן, אֶל, or לְ

senses.definition: Of the ground or earth, to cause vegetation to sprout and grow outward.
senses.grammatical_frame: Hiphil (causative stem), transitive with הָאָרֶץ as subject

senses.definition: To be led out or brought forth from a place (referring to surviving inhabitants).
senses.grammatical_frame: Hophal (passive of causative stem), participle

entries.collocations_and_notes: In the Qal (basic active) stem, the verb is intransitive and takes prepositions indicating source (מִן 'from', מֵעִם 'from the presence of', מִתּוֹךְ 'from the midst of') or goal/direction (אֶל 'to', לְ 'to', לִקְרַאת 'to meet', אַחֲרֵי 'after'). It frequently describes Israel's departure from Egypt (e.g., 1KI 6:1; PSA 114:1) and military mobilization (יֹצֵא צָבָא 'going out to military service', NUM 1:3; תֵצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה 'go out to battle', DEU 20:1). The Hiphil (causative) stem shifts the action to a transitive agent causing exit or emergence, commonly used for God bringing Israel out of Egypt (EXO 16:6; DEU 5:15), removing objects or people (NUM 15:36; EZR 1:7), rescuing from distress (PSA 18:20), or the earth producing plant life (GEN 1:12). The Hophal (passive of the causative stem) appears for people being brought out of a city (EZK 14:22).

entries.core_meaning_summary: To go or come back to a previous place, state, or course of action, and (in the causative stem) to bring back, restore, repay, or reply.

senses.definition: To move or go back to a starting point, former location, person, or original physical state; when paired with a verb of running, to dart back and forth.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal (basic active stem), intransitive, often with אֶל, לְ, directional -הָ, or מִן

senses.definition: To turn back or desist from an activity such as pursuit; to turn away from wicked conduct or transgressions; to turn back toward God in devotion; or, of anger, to subside and turn away.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal (basic active stem), intransitive with מִן + infinitive/noun, בְּ, or absolute

senses.definition: Used before another verb to indicate doing something once more or turning one's attention back to an observation.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal (basic active stem) coordinated with a following verb

senses.definition: To bring back the captive condition or restore the former well-being and fortunes of a people.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal (basic active stem), transitive with cognate-like object שְׁבוּת / שְׁבִית

senses.definition: To cause a person or thing to go back; to bring someone back, drive back an armed attack, hold back or restrain anger, or revoke a decreed punishment.
senses.grammatical_frame: Hiphil (causative stem), transitive with אֶת or object suffix, often with אֶל or directional adverb

senses.definition: To give back or repay money, property, or territory to its owner; to restore a community's fortunes; or, with 'hand' and עַל, to direct hostile power back against a target.
senses.grammatical_frame: Hiphil (causative stem), transitive with אֶת/object and לְ (recipient) or עַל

senses.definition: To bring back a report or reply in words to someone; with 'to their heart' (אֶל לֵב), to recall to mind and reflect seriously.
senses.grammatical_frame: Hiphil (causative stem), transitive with דָּבָר/מִלִּין or interrogative מָה, or idiomatically with אֶל לֵב

entries.collocations_and_notes: In the Qal (basic active) stem, the verb is predominantly intransitive and frequently pairs with spatial prepositions (אֶל 'to', לְ 'to', מִן 'from') or the directional suffix -הָ, as well as the paired infinitive absolute expression רָצוֹא וָשׁוֹב ('running back and forth', EZK 1:14). With מִן followed by an infinitive or noun of action/conduct (such as רְדֹף 'pursuing' or דַּרְכּוֹ הָרָעָה 'his evil way'), it denotes turning back from a pursuit or abandoning wrong behavior. Notably, the idiom 'restore the fortunes/captivity' appears in both the Qal stem (שָׁב שְׁבוּת / שְׁבִית, PSA 53:7; PSA 85:2) and the Hiphil (causative) stem (הֵשִׁיב שְׁבוּת, JER 33:7). The Hiphil stem also forms specialized idioms: הֵשִׁיב דָּבָר ('bring back word / report', JOS 22:32), הֵשִׁיב מִלִּין ('answer with words', JOB 35:4), הֵשִׁיב אֶל לֵב ('bring back to mind / take to heart', 1KI 8:47), הֵשִׁיב אַף ('turn back anger', JOB 9:13), and הֵשִׁיב יָד עַל ('turn one's hand against', EZK 38:12).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Preposition marking accompaniment, association, relational alignment or opposition, shared condition, and (with מִן) separation or source.

senses.definition: Indicating spatial proximity, accompaniment, companionship, or shared participation and fate (including the idiom of lying down or being buried with one's ancestors).
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition governing a noun phrase or pronominal suffix, often with verbs of motion, sitting, dwelling, or acting together

senses.definition: Marking inclusion alongside other items or persons in a list, social rank, or group estimation and memory.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition linking an entity or object to another group or set

senses.definition: Denoting relational alignment, loyal presence or military/divine backing, covenant partnership, standing before God, or possession and knowledge held by someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition in nominal clauses or with verbs of being, covenant-making (כָּרַת בְּרִית), or finding/understanding

senses.definition: Marking the opposing party in conflict, warfare, or hostile conduct.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition with verbs of fighting (נִלְחַם) or hostile conduct (הָלַךְ ... בְּקֶרִי)

senses.definition: Expressing temporal coexistence or duration alongside an enduring phenomenon.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition preceding a celestial noun (שָׁמֶשׁ) in parallel with a temporal phrase

senses.definition: Combined with מִן as מֵעִם to express separation or departure from someone's presence, originating divine agency, or a standard of comparison.
senses.grammatical_frame: Compound preposition מֵעִם with verbs of motion/departure, source clauses, or comparative adjectives (רַב מֵעִמּוֹ)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Takes pronominal suffixes with doubled mem (e.g., עִמִּי, עִמְּךָ, עִמּוֹ, עִמָּהּ, עִמָּנוּ, עִמָּכֶם, עִמָּם). Recurring idioms include שָׁכַב עִם אֲבֹתָיו ('lie down with one's fathers', referring to death, 1KI 15:8, 2KI 13:13), כָּרַת בְּרִית עִם ('make a covenant with', DEU 5:2, HOS 2:20), הָלַךְ עִם ('go with / support' in DEU 20:4, DEU 31:6; or 'act in hostility against' with קֶרִי in LEV 26:27), and נִלְחַם עִם ('fight against', DEU 20:4, 2CH 17:10). Often combined with מִן as מֵעִם to express separation, origin, or comparison.

entries.core_meaning_summary: To go, walk, travel, or conduct oneself along a course, and in the causative stem to lead or bring someone along a way.

senses.definition: To move physically from one place to another, depart, travel, crawl (of a serpent), march to battle, or go into exile, often accompanied by directional prepositions or adverbial phrases of accompaniment or route.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal); often with prepositions אֶל, מִן, לִפְנֵי, אַחֲרֵי, אִתִּי, locative ה-, or adverbials (יַחְדָּו, בַּגּוֹלָה)

senses.definition: Used immediately before another verb (especially in imperatives or consecutive narrative forms) to introduce or initiate a subsequent action, expressing movement undertaken in order to carry out that action.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) imperative or narrative past directly followed by a second imperative or consecutive verb

senses.definition: To conduct oneself, live according to a moral or religious pattern, follow a deity in loyalty or worship, or experience an ongoing emotional state.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) with prepositional phrases (בְּדֶרֶךְ, בְּיִרְאַת, אַחֲרֵי, עִם קֶרִי) or a descriptive participle (קֹדֵר)

senses.definition: To advance continuously in degree or status when paired with its own infinitive absolute and a following adjective or participle.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) finite verb + Qal infinitive absolute (הָלוֹךְ) + adjective/participle (וְגָדוֹל)

senses.definition: To cause someone to go, lead, guide, escort, or bring a person to a destination.
senses.grammatical_frame: Causative stem (Hiphil) taking a direct personal object (אֵת or pronominal suffix) and a goal expression (עַל, אֶל, or locative ה-)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired with a second verb to initiate an action (e.g., קוּם לֵךְ 'arise, go' in GEN 28:2, GEN 38:19, SNG 2:13; לֵךְ שֻׁב 'go, return' in EXO 4:19; לְכוּ וְהִכִּיתֶם in JDG 21:10) and with directional expressions using אֶל, מִן, אַחֲרֵי, אִתִּי, לִפְנֵי, or locative ה-. Idiomatic pairings include הָלַךְ הָלוֹךְ וְגָדוֹל (2SA 5:10, progressive growth), הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ / בְּיִרְאַת (moral/religious conduct, 1KI 16:26, NEH 5:9), הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי (following/allegiance to a deity, DEU 13:5, JER 7:6), הָלַךְ עִם קֶרִי (acting in hostility, LEV 26:21), and בַּגּוֹלָה יֵלֵךְ (going into exile, JER 49:3). In the simple active stem (Qal), the subject moves or conducts itself; in the causative stem (Hiphil), the subject causes or guides someone else to go (1KI 1:38, 2KI 6:19, JER 31:9, EZK 47:6).

entries.core_meaning_summary: The numeral 'one', functioning to count a single entity, denote uniqueness or solitude, express sameness or unity, distinguish an individual within a set, and mark the first day of a month.

senses.definition: Cardinal number indicating a quantity of one unit, person, item, or occurrence, as well as the unit digit in compound numerals (e.g., eleven, six hundred twenty-one) and tally lists.
senses.grammatical_frame: Attributive adjective following a singular noun, predicate tally numeral, or component of a compound numeral

senses.definition: Single, solitary, or alone, emphasizing individuality in contrast to a group or total absence in negative statements ('not even one').
senses.grammatical_frame: Substantive or predicate modifier, often in negative clauses with לֹא / אֵין or contrasted with a larger group

senses.definition: Identical, uniform, shared, or united, describing a single standard, measure, law, or unified mind/action shared by multiple items or people.
senses.grammatical_frame: Attributive modifier following nouns of measure, law, heart, or collective person (often in כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד 'as one man')

senses.definition: A particular or indefinite individual, one of a set, each individual member of a group, or one in correlation with another ('the one ... the other').
senses.grammatical_frame: Construct or absolute substantive with partitive מִן ('from/of'), definite attributive or correlative (הָאֶחָד ... הָאֶחָד), or indefinite noun modifier

senses.definition: Ordinal designation for the first day in calendrical date formulas.
senses.grammatical_frame: Substantive with preposition בְּ preceding לַחֹדֶשׁ ('of the month')

entries.collocations_and_notes: Inflects for gender (masculine אֶחָד, feminine אַחַת, construct אַחַד) and agrees with its noun when attributive, typically following the noun (e.g., פַּר אֶחָד, מִדָּה אַחַת). When definite (הָאֶחָד / הָאַחַת), it singles out one individual or paired item ('the one', 'each'). Notable idioms include מִדָּה אַחַת ('same/uniform measurement', EXO 26:2, EXO 36:15, 1KI 6:25), כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד ('as one man / united', JDG 20:11), לֵב אֶחָד ('one heart / single mind', 2CH 30:12), פַּעַם אֶחָת ('once', JOS 6:3), and בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ ('on the first day of the month', EXO 40:2, EZK 31:1). In negative clauses such as לֹא נִשְׁאַר אֶחָד (EXO 8:27) and אֵין גַּם־אֶחָד (PSA 14:3), it emphasizes complete absence ('not even one').

entries.core_meaning_summary: To take hold of, fetch, receive, seize, or acquire an object or person, extending from physical grasping to accepting offerings or bribes, capturing in war, appointing to a role, and taking a spouse.

senses.definition: To lay hold of, pick up, or carry an object or person physically, often in one's hand or arms.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) + direct object (often with בְּיָד 'in hand' or עַל־זְרוֹעֹת 'on arms'); also impersonal/passive plural in 2SA 23:6

senses.definition: To fetch, bring, retrieve, or procure someone or something from a source for use, delivery, or action, frequently paired with verbs of going or sending.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) + direct object, often with לְ ('for'), אֶל ('to'), or following הָלַךְ ('go') / שָׁלַח ('send')

senses.definition: To receive, collect, or accept something offered, due, or imparted, including sacrifices, tithes, levies, bribes, or moral instruction.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) + direct object, often with מִן / מִיַּד / מֵאֵת ('from' / 'from the hand of')

senses.definition: To capture, seize, arrest, or take possession of people, territory, or spoil by force or official authority.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) + direct object (persons, land, or collective wealth)

senses.definition: To take or remove a person from a prior setting in order to place, conscript, or appoint them to a task or office.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) + personal direct object + מִן ('from') or לְ ('for' / infinitive of purpose)

senses.definition: To take someone in marriage or as a sexual partner.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal) + personal object (woman/women or partners), sometimes with לְ ('for') or עַל ('in addition to')

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently appears in serial narrative chains preceding a verb of placement, wearing, sending, or action (e.g., GEN 2:15, GEN 22:6, GEN 27:15, 2KI 16:8). Common prepositional collocations include בְּיָד ('in hand', GEN 22:6, 2KI 9:1, 1KI 17:11), מִן / מִיַּד / מֵאֵת ('from' / 'from the hand of', NUM 5:25, NUM 18:26, JDG 13:23, JOB 35:7), and לְ indicating beneficiary or intended role (EXO 12:21, 1SA 8:13, 2KI 3:15). In 2SA 23:6, the third-person plural form יִקָּחוּ occurs with a negative ('not by hand') either impersonally ('people do not handle them') or as a passive ('they are not taken/handled'); all other forms in the sample are active simple-stem (Qal) usages. Idiomatic expressions include לָקַח שֹׁחַד ('accept a bribe', DEU 16:19, DEU 27:25) and לָקַח אִשָּׁה / נָשִׁים ('take a wife / wives', GEN 31:50, JDG 21:22).

entries.core_meaning_summary: To have mental awareness, factual knowledge, personal acquaintance, practical skill, or experiential familiarity (simple active stem), and to make known, inform, or reveal (causative stem).

senses.definition: To possess cognitive awareness or factual understanding of something, or to discern, ascertain, and find out a fact or state of affairs.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal); used with direct object, complement clause (kî / ʾăšer / interrogative), or absolutely

senses.definition: To be personally acquainted with someone or something, or to experience and encounter a condition, relationship, or deity firsthand.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal); transitive with direct object of a person, deity, condition, or way of life

senses.definition: To possess practical expertise, competence, or learned ability in a domain or course of action.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal); construct plural participle with domain noun, or finite verb + lĕ- + infinitive construct

senses.definition: To have sexual intercourse with a partner.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active stem (Qal); participle taking the object 'lying with a male' (miškab zākār)

senses.definition: To cause someone to know something; to inform, instruct, declare, or reveal.
senses.grammatical_frame: Causative stem (Hiphil); takes personal recipient (direct object or suffix) and/or content object or kî / ʾăšer clause

entries.collocations_and_notes: Observed in two stems: the simple active stem (Qal) for knowing, recognizing, experiencing, or possessing skill, and the causative stem (Hiphil) for informing, revealing, or teaching. Frequent patterns include the recognition formula 'you/they shall know that I am YHWH' (EXO 8:18, EZK 11:12, EZK 20:26, EZK 29:9); infinitive absolute + finite verb for certainty ('surely know', JOS 23:13); 'know good and evil' for moral discernment (GEN 3:5); 'know by name' for personal favor/intimacy (EXO 33:12); and 'know the way of peace' (ISA 59:8). Often paired with 'understand' (bîn) or 'learn' (lāmad) in parallelism (PSA 92:7, ISA 29:24).

entries.core_meaning_summary: The physical organ of sight, extended to attentive regard, emotional or moral disposition, personal judgment or approval ('in the eyes of'), public presence ('before the eyes of'), and the visible appearance or surface of things.

senses.definition: The bodily organ of vision in humans and symbolic beings, or anthropomorphically attributed to God; used for seeing, weeping, waking/sleeping, and directing expectant or watchful attention.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine noun (often dual or construct plural with pronominal suffixes); subject of verbs of seeing, opening, weeping, or failing, or object of 'lift up' (nāśāʾ)

senses.definition: The eye conceived as the seat or expression of an inward moral or emotional attitude toward another, either begrudging stinginess or sparing compassion.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine singular noun as subject of stative/active verbs ('be evil/grudging' with bĕ-, or 'spare/pity' with ʿal)

senses.definition: A person's or God's perspective, judgment, evaluation, or approval, expressed idiomatically by 'in the eyes of'.
senses.grammatical_frame: Prepositional phrase bĕʿênê ('in the eyes of') + noun or pronominal suffix, modifying evaluations ('good', 'evil', 'right', 'contemptible', 'find favor') or comparisons

senses.definition: The direct presence or open view of onlookers, denoting an action carried out visibly or publicly before witnesses.
senses.grammatical_frame: Prepositional phrase lĕʿênê ('to/for the eyes of') + noun or pronominal suffix

senses.definition: The outward look, color, or visible surface of a substance or of the land.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun in construct (ʿên hāʾāreṣ) or with suffix/comparison (kĕʿên)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequent idiomatic collocations include: 'to lift up one's eyes and see' (GEN 22:13, NUM 24:2); 'to find favor in the eyes of' (EXO 33:17, RUT 2:10, 2SA 15:25); 'to do what is evil/right/good in the eyes of' (JDG 2:11, 2KI 10:30, 1KI 21:2, PRO 12:15); 'open eyes' for attentive care (1KI 8:52, 2CH 6:40); 'your eye be evil against' for begrudging (DEU 15:9); 'my eye spared' for showing pity (EZK 20:17); and 'before the eyes of' for public witness (JER 39:6, EZK 38:23, ZEP 3:20). In comparative or landscape descriptions, it denotes outward look or visible surface (EXO 10:5, NUM 11:7). Dual endings appear for paired eyes (1SA 16:12, SNG 4:1, EZK 10:12).

entries.core_meaning_summary: To move, go, or come upward, and (causatively) to bring up, lift up, or place onto a surface.

senses.definition: To move physically upward or travel to a higher or central destination (such as a mountain, rooftop, sanctuary, city, or from Egypt/exile to the land).
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem; intransitive, with destination marked by direct object, directional ending, אֶל, or לְ, or origin by מִן

senses.definition: Of natural phenomena, plants, objects, or drawn lots: to rise upward, evaporate/lift, sprout, ascend in a balance scale, or come up in lot-casting.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem; intransitive with non-human or inanimate subject

senses.definition: To march up to battle or invade a territory (often with עַל 'against' or לַמִּלְחָמָה 'to war'), or with מֵעַל to withdraw/retreat from attacking someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem; intransitive with military goal (עַל / לְ) or separation (מֵעַל)

senses.definition: Figuratively, to intensify (of battle), to excel or surpass others (with עַל), or to come upon and weigh down someone (of transgressions/a yoke upon the neck).
senses.grammatical_frame: Basic active stem; intransitive or with עַל introducing the compared standard or affected body part

senses.definition: To be lifted up or taken up off a place (used of the cloud rising from over the tabernacle as the signal for Israel to set out).
senses.grammatical_frame: Passive/reflexive stem; infinitive construct with מֵעַל or pronoun subject

senses.definition: To cause someone or something to go up: to bring/lead people up a mountain or out of Egypt/the sea, to carry sacred objects up, to lift someone into a chariot, or to bring an invading army against a people.
senses.grammatical_frame: Causative stem; transitive with direct object and optional מִן ('from'), אֶל ('to'), or עַל ('against')

senses.definition: To set up or light lamps, to place or apply ornaments or embroidered figures onto garments/textiles, or to cause flesh to grow over bones.
senses.grammatical_frame: Causative stem; transitive with direct object and optional עַל ('upon')

entries.collocations_and_notes: Stem distinctions in context: the basic active stem expresses self-propelled upward movement, sprouting/rising, military advance/withdrawal, or figurative surpassing; the passive/reflexive stem expresses being lifted or taken up (EXO 40:36, NUM 9:22); the causative stem expresses bringing or leading someone or something up, setting up/lighting lamps, or placing/growing something onto a surface. Frequently pairs with directional ה־ (הָהָרָה, הַשָּׁמַיְמָה), מִן ('from', indicating point of departure such as Egypt or exile), אֶל/לְ ('to'), and עַל ('upon' or 'against' in military, comparative, or surface-contact contexts). Cognate noun מַעֲלֶה ('ascent') and infinitive absolute + finite verb construction ('עָלוּ עָלֹה', 2SA 15:30) also appear in context.

entries.core_meaning_summary: First-person singular independent personal pronoun denoting the speaker ('I').

senses.definition: Identifies the speaker or characterizes the speaker's state, identity, role, or presence as the subject of a verbless (nominal) clause, including divine self-identifications and oath formulas.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent pronoun as subject of a nominal (verbless) clause

senses.definition: Supplies the first-person singular grammatical subject for a participial predicate (which lacks person marking), often introduced by הִנֵּה ('behold') or a relative particle.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent pronoun as subject with a participle

senses.definition: Marks the first-person singular subject alongside a finite verb (whose inflection already marks person) to signal contrast, focus, inclusion ('I also'), exclusivity ('only I'), or coordination with another noun phrase.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent pronoun as emphatic, contrastive, or coordinated subject with a finite verb

senses.definition: Frames the speaker's perspective or counsel in an elliptical clause preceding an imperative/infinitive without an explicit verb of speaking.
senses.grammatical_frame: Fronted independent pronoun in an elliptical clause before a command/infinitive

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently prefixed with conjunction וַ־ ('and/but I', marking topic shift or contrast), כִּי ('for/that I'), or הִנֵּה ('behold, I'). Frequently appears in covenantal/divine self-identification formulas ('אֲנִי יְהוָה', 'אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם') and oath formulas ('חַי אָנִי', EZK 14:16). Takes pausal form אָנִי (e.g., JOB 33:6, PSA 119:63, EZK 9:8, EZK 14:16). Combines with גַּם ('I also'), רַק ... לְבַדִּי ('only I alone', JOB 1:17), and may be doubled ('אֲנִי אֲנִי', HOS 5:14) for strong emphasis. Alternates with the longer first-person pronoun אָנֹכִי in adjacent clauses (JDG 19:18, NEH 1:6, HOS 5:14).

entries.core_meaning_summary: To die or cease to live (basic intransitive stem), and in causative/intensive stems to put to death or be put to death.

senses.definition: To cease living or undergo physical death, whether of humans or animals, naturally, accidentally, as divine/legal judgment, or by violence. In the infinitive construct it refers to the event of dying ("death", EZK 33:11), and as a predicate participle it can express being dead or imminently about to die (JER 28:16).
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal (basic intransitive stem); often reinforced with infinitive absolute (מוֹת תָּמוּת) or with instrument marked by בְּ (e.g., sword, famine, stone)

senses.definition: Used figuratively of an abstract quality or institution coming to an end or disappearing completely along with its possessors.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal (basic intransitive stem) with an abstract noun subject (חָכְמָה, "wisdom")

senses.definition: As a participle functioning adjectivally or as a noun, refers to someone who is dead, a corpse, or collectively the deceased (often contrasted with the living).
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal participle used substantively (singular מֵת, plural מֵתִים) or adjectivally/appositionally

senses.definition: To cause a person to die, whether by execution, judicial authority, military action, or murder; expressed in both the causative active stem (Hiphil) and the intensive active stem (Polel, PSA 109:16).
senses.grammatical_frame: Hiphil (causative active stem) + direct object (person); also Polel (intensive active stem) in PSA 109:16

senses.definition: To be caused to die or be executed, commonly in legal statutes prescribing capital punishment (frequently reinforced by an emphatic infinitive absolute as מוֹת יוּמָת) or in warnings of imminent execution.
senses.grammatical_frame: Hophal (causative passive stem), frequently paired with an emphatic infinitive absolute (מוֹת יוּמָת) in legal decrees

entries.collocations_and_notes: Displays clear voice/causativity distinctions across verbal stems: Qal denotes the intransitive event of dying (often reinforced emphatically by an infinitive absolute + finite verb, מוֹת תָּמוּת "you shall surely die", GEN 2:17, GEN 20:7); Hiphil expresses causing someone's death ("to kill, put to death", e.g., 1SA 19:11, 2SA 4:7); Polel similarly expresses slaying/killing (PSA 109:16); and Hophal expresses the passive of causation ("to be put to death, executed", often paired with an emphatic infinitive absolute as מוֹת יוּמָת in legal penalties, EXO 21:12, LEV 20:27). The Qal participle מֵת serves both predicatively ("is dead / about to die", JER 28:16) and substantively ("a dead person, corpse, the dead", NUM 19:11, ISA 8:19). Frequently contrasted with living (חָיָה / חַיִּים, e.g., 2KI 5:7, ISA 8:19, EZK 33:11) and paired with means of death using בְּ ("by sword, famine, plague", JER 42:17).

entries.core_meaning_summary: A spatial adverb pointing to a previously identified or distinct location, expressing position at, motion toward, or separation from that place ("there", "thither", "from there").

senses.definition: Indicates a stationary location or setting at which someone or something exists, remains, or performs an action, at a place distinct from the speaker's immediate vantage point; usually with the bare form שָׁם, and occasionally with the suffixed form שָׁמָּה in locative contexts.
senses.grammatical_frame: Locative adverb (bare שָׁם, or occasionally suffixed שָׁמָּה) modifying verbs of being, dwelling, placing, or action, or serving as predicate in verbless clauses

senses.definition: Indicates direction or motion toward a previously specified or distant place, typically marked with the directional suffix (-āh) as שָׁמָּה following verbs of going, entering, or arriving.
senses.grammatical_frame: Directional adverb with directional ending (שָׁמָּה) complementing verbs of motion or entry

senses.definition: Marks separation, removal, origin, or vantage point from a specified location, formed with the prefixed preposition מִן ("from") as מִשָּׁם.
senses.grammatical_frame: Prepositional-adverbial compound (מִן + שָׁם = מִשָּׁם) with verbs of departing, taking, bringing out, or observing

senses.definition: Functions as a resumptive spatial marker inside a relative clause introduced by אֲשֶׁר (or correlatively with בַּאֲשֶׁר), linking the antecedent place back to the action or state in the clause ("where", "to which", or "from which" depending on whether bare שָׁם, directional שָׁמָּה, or separative מִשָּׁם is used).
senses.grammatical_frame: Resumptive adverb (שָׁם / שָׁמָּה / מִשָּׁם) inside an אֲשֶׁר relative clause or correlative with בַּאֲשֶׁר

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently appears in three distinct morphological configurations: (1) bare שָׁם for static location ("there"); (2) with the directional suffix ה־ as שָׁמָּה for motion toward a place ("to there, thither"), though occasionally also used for static location (e.g., GEN 23:13, 2SA 21:12); and (3) with prefixed preposition מִן as מִשָּׁם for separation or origin ("from there"). Very commonly used as a resumptive spatial adverb inside relative clauses introduced by אֲשֶׁר ("the place which ... there" = "where") or correlatively with בַּאֲשֶׁר ("where ... there", JDG 5:27). Frequently collocates with verbs of dwelling/sitting (יָשַׁב), placing (שִׂים), burying/hiding, eating, and worshipping, as well as existential/presentative particles like הִנֵּה ("behold, there!", GEN 29:2, EZK 8:14).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Negative particle of non-existence and non-possession ('there is not, no, none, without'), negating nominal, existential, possessive, and participial clauses.

senses.definition: Asserts the non-existence or absence of an entity, condition, or class, or asks whether such does not exist.
senses.grammatical_frame: Absolute form (אַיִן) following a noun or as clause predicate, or construct form (אֵין) preceding a noun, pronoun, or adverb (including interrogative הַאֵין)

senses.definition: Negates possession, share, or accompaniment with respect to a person or entity.
senses.grammatical_frame: Construct אֵין followed by preposition לְ-, עִם, or אֵת marking the possessor or companion

senses.definition: Negates an ongoing action or state expressed by a participle, either for a specified subject or universally ('there is no one who...').
senses.grammatical_frame: Construct אֵין or pronominal-suffixed form (e.g., אֵינְכֶם) governing a participle, with or without an explicit subject

senses.definition: Expresses the disappearance, death, or total absence of a person or thing.
senses.grammatical_frame: Particle with pronominal suffix (אֵינֶנִּי, אֵינֶנּוּ, אֵינָם) functioning as the complete predicate of a clause

senses.definition: Marks total lack, limitlessness, or privation as an attributive or prepositional qualifier.
senses.grammatical_frame: Construct אֵין following prepositions (לְ-, עַד) or coordinated by וְ as an attributive modifier before a noun

entries.collocations_and_notes: Appears in the absolute state (אַיִן) at clause end or after its subject (GEN 2:5; 1SA 10:14), in the construct state (אֵין) before nouns, participles, or prepositional phrases, and with pronominal suffixes (e.g., אֵינֶנִּי, אֵינֶנּוּ, אֵינָם, אֵינְכֶם). Common constructions include the negation of possession אֵין לְ- ('has no', e.g., NUM 27:9; EST 2:7; LAM 1:2), interrogative הַאֵין ('is there not?', 1KI 22:7; הַאַף אֵין in AMO 2:11), exhaustive negation וְאֵין עוֹד ('and there is no other', ISA 45:18), quantitative/limit phrases עַד אֵין מִסְפָּר ('beyond number', PSA 40:13), and formulaic phrases depicting desolation or helplessness such as וְאֵין מַצִּיל ('with none rescuing', JDG 18:28), וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד ('with none causing fear', LEV 26:6), and וְאֵין שָׁלֹם ('and there is no peace', JER 30:5; EZK 13:16).

entries.core_meaning_summary: Demonstrative and correlative adverb indicating manner, likeness, or conformity ('so, thus, in this way'), also forming prepositional discourse connectives meaning 'therefore' and 'afterward', plus one inflected nominal occurrence meaning 'office/position'.

senses.definition: In this manner or way, referring back to a previously stated action, instruction, or condition; likewise or similarly.
senses.grammatical_frame: Standalone adverb modifying a verb or verbless clause

senses.definition: Correspondingly or in the same manner or degree, introducing the second half of a comparison or proportionality clause.
senses.grammatical_frame: Correlative adverb paired with a preceding comparative clause or phrase (כַּאֲשֶׁר, כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר, כְּ-)

senses.definition: For this reason or on account of what was just stated, marking logical consequence, inference, or divine judgment.
senses.grammatical_frame: Compound prepositional connective (לָכֵן, עַל־כֵּן, or כִּי עַל־כֵּן) introducing a result or proclamation

senses.definition: After that event or under these circumstances, marking temporal sequence or situational transition.
senses.grammatical_frame: Compound prepositional phrase with temporal or situational prepositions (אַחֲרֵי כֵן, וּבְכֵן)

senses.definition: An official post, station, or position to which someone is restored.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun governed by preposition עַל with first-person singular suffix (עַל כַּנִּי)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently combines with prepositions to form discourse connectives: לָכֵן ('therefore', e.g., NUM 16:11; ISA 5:24; JER 14:15; EZK 5:11, often introducing prophetic declarations with כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה), עַל־כֵּן ('therefore / for this reason', e.g., 1CH 17:25; JOB 22:10; PSA 45:18; AMO 3:2; HAB 1:4; strengthened as כִּי עַל־כֵּן in JDG 6:22), אַחֲרֵי כֵן ('afterward', GEN 23:19; 2CH 24:4), and וּבְכֵן ('and then / in this situation', EST 4:16). Regularly pairs correlatively with כַּאֲשֶׁר, כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר, or כְּ- ('just as ... so', e.g., EXO 1:12; EXO 40:16; DEU 12:22; JER 5:27; EZK 34:12) and appears in the formulaic affirmation וַיְהִי כֵן ('and it became so', GEN 1:7) and execution formula וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן ('and he did so', JOS 5:15; NUM 5:4). In GEN 41:13, alongside the adverbial כֵּן הָיָה, the inflected nominal form כַּנִּי ('my office/post') is tagged under this lemma ID in the packet.

entries.core_meaning_summary: To utter a call, cry out, summon, name, proclaim, or read aloud, with a passive/middle usage for being called/summoned or chancing to meet.

senses.definition: To raise one's voice in a loud cry, shout, or vocal call, either absolutely or directed toward someone to gain attention or deliver an utterance.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active verb (Qal), used absolutely, with direct speech, or with אֶל ('to') or בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל ('with a loud voice')

senses.definition: To call upon or cry out to God in prayer, worship, or urgent distress, seeking help or an answer.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active verb (Qal) with divine name as direct object, after אֶל ('to'), in בְּשֵׁם ('in the name of'), or used absolutely in prayer contexts

senses.definition: To summon or invite a person or group to appear or participate; in the passive stem or passive participle, to be summoned or invited.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active verb (Qal) with לְ or אֶל + person summoned (and passive participle הַקְּרוּאִים 'the invited ones'); passive stem (Niphal) in EST 8:9

senses.definition: To assign a name, title, or descriptive designation to a person, place, or thing; in the passive stem, to be named or called by a name.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active verb (Qal) with לְ + recipient + name, or with שֵׁם ('name') + name; passive stem (Niphal) in ISA 48:1 and EZK 20:29

senses.definition: To proclaim or declare a public observance (such as a fast), or to read a written document or scroll aloud before listeners.
senses.grammatical_frame: Simple active verb (Qal) with direct object denoting an observance (צוֹם) or written text (often with בְּאָזְנֵי 'in the hearing of')

senses.definition: To happen to meet or come unexpectedly before someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Passive/middle stem (Niphal) with לִפְנֵי ('before') + persons encountered

entries.collocations_and_notes: Across the observed verses, the simple active stem (Qal) expresses calling aloud, praying, summoning, naming, and reading aloud, whereas the passive/reflexive stem (Niphal) expresses being summoned (EST 8:9), being named or called by a title (ISA 48:1, EZK 20:29), and in one instance happening to encounter someone unexpectedly (2SA 18:9). Common collocations include קָרָא בְשֵׁם ('invoke/call upon the name of', GEN 12:8), קָרָא לְ... ('summon' or 'name X as Y', GEN 1:5, 2KI 4:15), קָרָא אֶל ('call out to / pray to', EXO 19:3, JER 33:3), קָרָא בְקוֹל גָּדוֹל ('shout with a loud voice', 2KI 18:28), and קָרָא בְּאָזְנֵי ('read aloud in the hearing of', 2CH 34:30, JER 36:21). In HOS 11:7 (וְאֶל עַל יִקְרָאֻהוּ), the poetic syntax of the prepositional phrase and pronominal object is concise and somewhat obscure, though the verb still denotes calling or appealing upward.

entries.core_meaning_summary: The cardinal number two, denoting a pair of entities, a component in compound numbers, or a twofold quantity.

senses.definition: Expressing the exact quantity of two items, persons, or groups, either modifying a noun (in construct before or in absolute before/after the noun) or with a plural pronominal suffix denoting both members of a pair.
senses.grammatical_frame: Numeral in construct before plural noun, in absolute state modifying noun, or in construct with plural pronominal suffix

senses.definition: Standing independently without an explicit counted noun to denote two individuals, two items, or two occasions, or repeated to express distributive grouping ('two each').
senses.grammatical_frame: Absolute numeral standing substantively as subject, object of preposition, or repeated distributively

senses.definition: Combining with ten ('twelve') or higher multiples of ten ('twenty-two', 'forty-two', etc.) to form compound cardinal or ordinal numerals.
senses.grammatical_frame: Numeral in compound numerical phrase with ten or multiples of ten

senses.definition: Expressing a twofold amount, double restitution, or a double share, either independently as an adverbial/substantive quantity or in construct after פִּי ('portion/measure').
senses.grammatical_frame: Absolute numeral as direct object of restitution verb, or in construct phrase פִּי שְׁנַיִם

entries.collocations_and_notes: Exhibits gender agreement with the counted noun: masculine forms שְׁנַיִם / שְׁנֵי (construct) and feminine forms שְׁתַּיִם / שְׁתֵּי (construct). Frequently takes pronominal suffixes in construct (שְׁנֵיהֶם 'both of them', e.g., EXO 22:8, NUM 25:8, DEU 23:19, PRO 20:10, often reinforced by גַּם 'even both'). Combines with עָשָׂר / עֶשְׂרֵה for 'twelve' (NUM 7:78, JOS 18:24) and with tens for compound numbers (e.g., עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם 'twenty-two', 1KI 16:29). Forms distributive pairs by repetition (שְׁנַיִם שְׁנָיִם 'two by two / two each', 1CH 26:17), the adverbial expression פַּעַם וּשְׁתָּיִם 'once or twice' (NEH 13:20), and the idiom פִּי שְׁנַיִם 'a double portion' (2KI 2:9).

entries.core_meaning_summary: A noun denoting a living creature or human person, physical vitality and life, the inner seat of desire and emotion, or a reflexive personal self.

senses.definition: An animate living creature, whether human or animal, viewed as an embodied living being.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, singular absolute or construct (e.g., נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה, נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֵמָה)

senses.definition: An individual human being or person, especially in legal stipulations, enumerations, or characterizations of moral and social conduct.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, singular or plural, often with כָּל, demonstrative הַהִוא, or descriptive modifier
senses.semantic_domain: Human Beings / Legal and Social Status

senses.definition: Physical life or mortal existence as something that can be preserved, ransomed, endangered, hunted, struck down, or taken away.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, usually with pronominal suffix or in construct, object of verbs of saving, seeking, striking, or ransoming

senses.definition: The inner seat of appetite, craving, longing, distress, devotion, and emotional responsiveness.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun with pronominal suffix, subject of verbs of emotion/appetite or governed by prepositions (בְּכָל, לְ)

senses.definition: Personal or reflexive reference equivalent to 'myself', 'herself', 'themselves', or 'me' in self-directed speech, vows, or actions.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun with pronominal suffix functioning as reflexive pronoun, vocative self-address, or emphatic subject/object

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently parallels לֵבָב ('heart'), מְאֹד ('strength/might', 2KI 23:25), עַיִן ('eye'), and בֶּטֶן ('belly', PSA 31:10), showing its role as the holistic inner self or vital center. Common idioms include שִׂים נַפְשׁוֹ בְכַפּוֹ ('put one's life in one's hand', i.e., risk one's life: 1SA 28:21; cf. PSA 119:109), בִּקֵּשׁ אֶת נֶפֶשׁ ('seek someone's life', 1SA 20:1, JER 19:9), מִלֵּט אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ ('deliver one's life', 1KI 1:12, JER 51:45), הִכָּה נָפֶשׁ ('strike fatally', DEU 19:6; cf. LEV 24:18), and כֹּפֶר נֶפֶשׁ ('ransom for a life', EXO 30:12, NUM 35:31). Often occurs in the legal formula וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ ('that person shall be cut off from his people', LEV 7:27, LEV 19:8, NUM 15:30). Plural נְפָשׁוֹת appears in EZK 13:18 and JOS 9:24.

entries.core_meaning_summary: An interrogative pronoun and adverbial particle asking about identity, nature, action, cause, or degree, and functioning in prepositional compounds and rhetorical or indefinite expressions.

senses.definition: Interrogative pronoun asking about the identity, character, content, or action of a thing, event, or situation, functioning as subject, predicate, or direct object in direct questions.
senses.grammatical_frame: Interrogative pronoun functioning as subject, nominal predicate, or object of finite verb or לְ + infinitive construct

senses.definition: Interrogative or indefinite pronoun introducing an indirect question or an unspecified event/outcome as the complement of verbs of perception or cognition.
senses.grammatical_frame: Clause-initial complement after verbs of seeing or knowing (רָאָה, יָדַע)

senses.definition: Interrogative adverbial compound with prepositions (לְ or עַל) asking for the reason, cause, purpose, or basis of an action or state, often carrying a note of reproach or protest.
senses.grammatical_frame: Prepositional compound לָמָּה / לָמָה or עַל מָה / עַל מֶה introducing a clause

senses.definition: Rhetorical or exclamatory marker expressing futility, insufficiency, inability, astonishment at brevity/degree, or disavowal of shared obligation or involvement.
glosses: what have I to do with
senses.grammatical_frame: Interrogative particle in rhetorical clauses, comparisons, or the formula מַה לִּי וָלָךְ

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently combines with prepositions to form causal or purposeful interrogatives, most notably לָמָּה / לָמָה (with לְ, 'why?') and עַל מָה / עַל מֶה (with עַל, 'for what reason? / on what basis?'). Often reinforced by the demonstrative זֶה (e.g., לָמָּה זֶּה in GEN 25:32, 1SA 26:18, 2SA 3:24, JER 6:20). Forms the fixed idiomatic expression of disengagement or protest מַה לִּי וָלָךְ ('what [is there] to me and to you?', 1KI 17:18). Also used with infinitive constructs (מַה לַעֲשׂוֹת, EST 6:6, ISA 5:4) and in rhetorical questions that imply negation, futility, or inability (JOB 9:2, JOB 21:15, LAM 2:13). Pointing varies between מָה, מַה (often with dagesh in the following consonant), and מֶה (especially before gutturals or in pause/fixed phrases).

entries.core_meaning_summary: The second-person masculine singular independent personal pronoun ('you'), used as the explicit subject of verbal, nominal, and participial clauses or as a fronted topic.

senses.definition: Serves as the explicit masculine singular subject of a finite verb (perfect, imperfect, or imperative), typically marking emphasis, contrast with another participant, shift of focus, or inclusion in a coordinated compound subject.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent personal pronoun (2ms) as subject of a finite verb

senses.definition: Serves as the subject of a verbless (nominal) or participial clause, identifying or characterizing a masculine singular addressee with a noun phrase, adjective, participle, or prepositional phrase.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent personal pronoun (2ms) as subject of a nominal or participial predicate

senses.definition: Stands at the front of a sentence as an extraposed topic addressing a masculine singular person, whose grammatical role in the main clause is resumed by a second-person pronominal suffix.
senses.grammatical_frame: Extraposed topic (casus pendens) resumed by a 2ms pronominal suffix

entries.collocations_and_notes: Commonly preceded by the conjunction וְ (וְאַתָּה, marking contrast, shift of speaker/actor, or circumstantial background, e.g., GEN 21:26, GEN 32:13, NEH 9:28, ISA 33:1), by כִּי ('for/that you', e.g., GEN 3:11, DEU 31:23, PSA 5:13, JON 4:2), by הִנֵּה ('behold, you', 1SA 8:5, 1SA 28:9), by הֲלֹא in rhetorical questions (PSA 60:12), or by אִם in conditional clauses (EXO 10:4, JDG 7:10, JER 38:21). Frequently paired with vocatives such as יְהוָה, אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה, אֱלֹהִים, אֱלֹהֵינוּ, or בֶן־אָדָם (DEU 3:24, 2SA 7:24, EZR 9:13, EZK 21:11, EZK 43:10), and with לְבַדְּךָ ('you alone', 1KI 8:39). Appears in pausal form אָתָּה in GEN 3:11 and ISA 48:4.

entries.core_meaning_summary: A negative particle used primarily before jussive, cohortative, or imperfect verb forms to express prohibitions, warnings, and negative wishes, with one anomalous interrogative occurrence before a perfect verb.

senses.definition: Negates a second-person jussive or imperfect verb to express a direct prohibition, warning, moral instruction, or urgent plea directed at one or more addressees.
senses.grammatical_frame: Negative particle + 2nd-person jussive or imperfect verb (often with נָא)

senses.definition: Negates a third-person jussive or first-person plural cohortative/imperfect verb to express a negative wish, prayer, stipulation, or desired prevention of an event.
senses.grammatical_frame: Negative particle + 3rd-person jussive or 1st-person plural imperfect verb

senses.definition: Functions before a perfect verb to introduce a question concerning the place or target of a military raid, answered with prepositional phrases specifying locations.
senses.grammatical_frame: Interrogative particle + 2nd-person plural perfect verb

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently combined with the entreaty particle נָא (אַל־נָא, 'please do not / let there not be', GEN 13:8, GEN 47:29) and often joined by the conjunction וְ (וְאַל, 'and do not / and let not', or contrastive 'but do not' in ISA 6:9). Can occur in a series of prohibitions or negative wishes (PRO 3:11; JER 16:5; JON 3:7), with a preceding subject noun such as אִישׁ to negate an entire group ('let no one', HOS 4:4), or with a preceding vocative (אֱלֹהִים, PSA 71:12; בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, 2CH 13:12). In JOS 22:19, the second occurrence is pointed אֶל in the text alongside the first אַל. In 1SA 27:10, אַל stands anomalously before a perfect verb (פְּשַׁטְתֶּם) in a question that is answered by spatial/target prepositional phrases ('against the Negev of...').

entries.core_meaning_summary: Noun denoting a physical road, route, or journey, and by extension spatial direction, human conduct, or divine standards and dealings.

senses.definition: A physical track, road, highway, or passageway along which people or animals travel or pass.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular or plural noun, often as object of verbs of motion/guarding or governed by the preposition בְּ or עַל

senses.definition: An act of traveling, an expedition, or the spatial distance measured by travel over a specified number of days.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun with pronominal suffix, in construct with a time unit (דֶּרֶךְ יוֹם, דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים), or governed by לְ or בְּ with verbs of going/returning

senses.definition: Spatial orientation, direction toward a destination, or route of entry or passage.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun in construct standing adverbially without a preposition before a place-name or architectural noun

senses.definition: A person's habitual conduct, moral behavior, or chosen course of life, and by extension the deeds for which one is held accountable.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular or plural noun, often with possessive suffixes, moral adjectives (יָשָׁר, רָעָה), or verbs of walking, keeping, mending, or turning away

senses.definition: God's characteristic mode of action and dealings, or the standard of conduct he prescribes for people to follow.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular or plural noun in construct with the divine name or with divine possessive suffixes, frequently as object of לָלֶכֶת בְּ or יָדַע

entries.collocations_and_notes: Displays variable gender agreement in the sample: modified by masculine adjectives (יָשָׁר in PRO 12:15, PRO 16:25; יְשָׁרִים in HOS 14:10) yet takes feminine pronominal reference in 1SA 9:6 (עָלֶיהָ) and PRO 16:25 (וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ). Frequently paired with verbs of motion (הלך בְּ, עבר בְּ, שוב מִן, בּוֹא) and moral verbs (שׁמר, ידע, ישר, היטיב). Used adverbially without a preposition to denote direction or route ('by way of', 'toward') in DEU 1:19, 2CH 6:34, ISA 15:5, and EZK 46:2. Common collocations include דֶּרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ ('the king's highway'), עוֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ ('travelers on the road'), דֶּרֶךְ יוֹם / דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים (distance of travel), דַּרְכֵי יְהוָה ('the ways of YHWH'), and דַּרְכּוֹ הָרָעָה ('his evil way').

entries.core_meaning_summary: Proclitic interrogative particle prefixed to the opening constituent of a clause to mark yes/no, alternative, or rhetorical questions.

senses.definition: Marks a direct yes/no question asking whether an action occurred, will occur, or whether a state holds true, prefixed to the fronted verb, pronoun, existential particle, or prepositional phrase.
senses.grammatical_frame: Inseparable proclitic particle prefixed to the first word of a direct verbal, nominal, or existential interrogative clause

senses.definition: Introduces the first member of a two-part disjunctive or alternative question, paired with אִם introducing the second alternative.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic particle in the first clause paired with אִם in the second clause

senses.definition: Introduces a rhetorical or deliberative question expressing disbelief, rebuke, astonishment, or an implied negative answer.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic particle prefixed to finite verbs, infinitive absolutes, pronouns, or prepositional phrases in rhetorical clauses

senses.definition: Combines with the negative particle לֹא/לוֹא to frame an assertive rhetorical question expecting an affirmative answer, appealing to shared knowledge or obvious fact.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic particle prefixed directly to לֹא or לוֹא at the head of a clause

senses.definition: Marks an elliptical or indirect interrogative phrase following a verb of perceiving or seizing upon a spoken clue, indicating inquiry as to whether something came from the speaker.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic particle prefixed to a prepositional phrase (הֲמִמֶּנּוּ) functioning as an elliptical complement after a finite verb

entries.collocations_and_notes: Exhibits vowel variation before gutturals or certain prefixes in the sample: standard הֲ (e.g., הֲלֹא, הֲתֵלֵךְ) alternates with הַ (e.g., הַאַתָּה in 1KI 13:14, הַאֵין in 2KI 3:11, הַעַל in NEH 2:19 and ISA 64:11, הַֽעוֹד in RUT 1:11, הַאֲקַדְּמֶנּוּ in MIC 6:6). Frequently combines with לֹא/לוֹא as הֲלֹא/הֲלוֹא to form affirmative rhetorical appeals, and with אִם in alternative questions (הֲ... אִם...). Can attach directly to verbs (finite or infinitive absolute as in JER 7:9 and JER 40:14), pronouns, nouns, particles (רַק, גַּם, עוֹד), and prepositional phrases (הֲמִן in GEN 3:11, הַעַל in NEH 2:19, הֲמִמֶּנּוּ in 1KI 20:33).

entries.core_meaning_summary: To lift up, carry, or transport physical objects, raise one's voice, banner, or gesture, endure moral guilt or disgrace, enter specific idiomatic actions (such as taking a census or showing partiality), and (in the passive stem) be exalted.

senses.definition: To pick up, support, carry, or transport a physical load, object, or person from one place to another, or (with מֵעַל / wind) to sweep or strip something away.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal basic active stem + direct object (physical item or person), often with locative phrases (עַל, בְּ, מִן, מֵעַל)

senses.definition: To raise something upward as a visible sign, posture, gesture, or inner orientation: hoisting a banner, lifting one's face unashamed, raising one's hand in an oath, or directing one's soul toward God.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal basic active stem + direct object (נֵס, פָּנִים, יָד, נֶפֶשׁ), often with directional prepositions לְ or אֶל

senses.definition: To raise one's voice or begin a loud vocal utterance such as calling out, weeping, or chanting a lament.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal basic active stem + direct object designating voice or vocal genre (קוֹל, בְּכִי, קִינָה)

senses.definition: To bear the burden, liability, or punitive consequence of guilt, sin, shame, or terror.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal basic active stem + abstract object of burden or culpability (עָוֺן, חֵטְא, כְּלִמָּה, אֵמִים)

senses.definition: To perform conventionalized social or administrative acts expressed by fixed object pairings: taking a head-count/census (+ רֹאשׁ), taking wives in marriage (+ לְ + נָשִׁים), or showing partiality toward someone (+ פְּנֵי).
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal basic active stem in fixed idiomatic collocations with רֹאשׁ, לְ + נָשִׁים, or פְּנֵי + person

senses.definition: To be lifted high or exalted in status and prominence.
senses.grammatical_frame: Niphal passive/reflexive stem, intransitive, paired with verbs of height and elevation

entries.collocations_and_notes: Exhibits well-defined idiomatic object pairings in the Qal stem: with קוֹל ("voice") or lament terms (בְּכִי, קִינָה) it means to raise a cry or dirge; with נֵס it means to hoist a signal banner; with עָוֺן, חֵטְא, or כְּלִמָּה it means to bear guilt, punishment, or disgrace; with יָד + לְ it expresses raising the hand to swear an oath (EZK 20:15); with רֹאשׁ it means to take a count/census (NUM 31:49); with לְ + נָשִׁים it means to take wives (2CH 13:21); and with פְּנֵי (another's face) it means to show partiality (JOB 34:19), whereas with one's own face (JOB 11:15) it expresses looking up unashamed. In the Niphal stem (ISA 52:13) it expresses being lifted up or exalted alongside verbs of height.

entries.core_meaning_summary: To rise up physically from a lower or resting posture, initiate an action or hostile confrontation, endure or hold valid, and (in causative/intensive stems) erect, rouse, uphold, or ratify.

senses.definition: To change posture by rising from a lying, sitting, sleeping, or fallen position, often contrasted with sitting or lying down or followed by an infinitive expressing purpose.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal basic active stem, intransitive; often contrasted with verbs of sitting/lying or followed by לְ + infinitive

senses.definition: To bestir oneself to begin a journey, undertaking, or decisive intervention, commonly linked directly with a second verb of motion or action.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal basic active stem, intransitive; frequently imperative or narrative sequential form paired with a verb of motion or action

senses.definition: To move aggressively or come forward in opposition against someone, whether in physical assault or legal accusation.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal basic active stem + preposition אֶל, עַל, or בְּ introducing the target; also used as a substantivized participle

senses.definition: To step into a role or position of power in succession to predecessors, or for a state of tumult to break out among a population.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal basic active stem + תַּחַת (in place of) or עַל (over), or with an event noun as subject

senses.definition: To remain firm, endure, succeed, or hold valid, said of a legal case, kingship, plans, or an agreement.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qal basic active stem, intransitive with abstract or institutional subjects

senses.definition: To cause a structure to stand upright by assembling or erecting it, or to rouse a resting creature to its feet.
senses.grammatical_frame: Hiphil causative stem + direct object (physical structure or animate suffix)

senses.definition: To bring an opponent into active hostility against someone, or to uphold and carry out an authoritative command.
senses.grammatical_frame: Hiphil causative stem + direct object (person in opposition or command)

senses.definition: To confirm, establish, or make an official written directive binding.
senses.grammatical_frame: Piel intensive/factitive stem + direct object (official letter/decree)

senses.definition: To set oneself up in active resistance or hostility against someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Hithpolel reflexive/reciprocal stem participle + preposition לְ

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired in narrative and commands with verbs of motion such as הָלַךְ ("go"), בָּרַח ("flee"), or שׁוּב ("return") to mark the start of an action or journey. Often contrasted with שָׁכַב ("lie down") or יָשַׁב ("sit"). With אֶל or עַל (and as a substantive participle הַקָּמִים עָלַי) it expresses hostile opposition or attack. In legal and treaty contexts (DEU 19:15; ISA 28:18) it denotes validity or standing firm, while in the causative Hiphil and intensive Piel stems it shifts from intransitive rising to setting up objects, raising adversaries, carrying out commands, or ratifying documents.

entries.core_meaning_summary: A noun denoting the anatomical head of a person and, by extension, the top or upper part of things, a leader or chief, a military unit, a counted sum or principal, the temporal beginning, the choicest quality, or (when paired with wormwood) a bitter toxic plant.

senses.definition: The physical head of a human being, appearing in contexts of blessing, anointing, mourning gestures, execution, protection in battle, and physical discomfort or shelter.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun, often in construct or with pronominal suffixes and prepositions (עַל, לְ, בְּ)

senses.definition: The person as the locus of moral accountability, used in judicial and retributive expressions where bloodguilt, conduct, or a wicked scheme returns or is placed upon the perpetrator.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun with pronominal suffix following prepositions עַל or בְּ with verbs of returning or giving (שׁוּב, נָתַן)

senses.definition: The uppermost part, summit, or capital of a physical structure or geographical feature, as well as a branch or stream dividing from a main river.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular or plural noun, often in construct (רֹאשׁ הָהָר) or with suffix referring to architectural elements

senses.definition: A person holding supreme or representative authority over a family, ancestral house, clan, people, military force, or kingdom, as well as a capital city exercising dominance over a territory.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular or plural noun, frequently in construct (רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת, רָאשֵׁי הָעָם, רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁלִישִׁים) or as predicate with verbs of appointing (שִׂים, נָתַן)

senses.definition: An organized military detachment, company, or raiding column operating as a distinct unit.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun with article and numeral (הָרֹאשׁ אֶחָד) as subject of verb of movement (פָּנָה)

senses.definition: The total head-count or census sum of a population group, or the original principal sum of property owed before an added penalty.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun in the census idiom נָשָׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ, or with preposition בְּ in restitution law (שִׁלַּם בְּרֹאשׁוֹ)

senses.definition: The starting point or earliest time in a sequence or in history, contrasted with the end or later generations.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun governed by preposition מִן (מֵרֹאשׁ), paired or contrasted with סוֹף ("end") or אַחֲרֹנִים ("last ones")

senses.definition: The highest grade or finest portion of a valuable commodity or trade good.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun in construct before כָּל + commodity noun (בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל בֹּשֶׂם)

senses.definition: A bitter or poisonous plant or substance, paired with wormwood to evoke severe affliction or destructive religious unfaithfulness.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun coordinated with לַעֲנָה ("wormwood") as object of bearing (פֹּרֶה) or remembrance

entries.collocations_and_notes: Frequently appears in construct phrases for clan and civic leadership (רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת / רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת, "heads of ancestral houses"; רָאשֵׁי הָעָם, "heads of the people"). Idiomatic verbal expressions include נָשָׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ ("take a count/census", NUM 4:22, NUM 31:49), הֵרִים רֹאשׁ ("lift up [someone's] head", restoring honor/confidence, PSA 3:4), הֵנִיד בְּרֹאשׁ ("shake/wag the head" in shock or derision, JER 18:16), and returning/placing blood, conduct, or plots עַל רֹאשׁ / בְּרֹאשׁ ("upon the head" of the responsible person, 1KI 2:32, 1KI 8:32, EST 9:25, EZK 11:21). In DEU 29:17 and LAM 3:19, רֹאשׁ is paired with לַעֲנָה ("wormwood") to denote a bitter or toxic plant/substance; although identically pointed in the text, this usage is semantically distinct from the "head/top/chief" cluster.

entries.core_meaning_summary: Feminine singular proximal demonstrative pronoun and adjective referring to a nearby or contextually salient feminine entity, object, statement, event, or situation ("this", "this one").

senses.definition: Demonstrative adjective modifying a definite feminine singular noun (and any accompanying attributive adjective), identifying a specific nearby or contextually highlighted entity, place, or object.
senses.grammatical_frame: Attributive feminine singular demonstrative with definite article following a definite feminine singular noun (הַ + noun + הַזֹּאת)

senses.definition: Independent pronoun pointing to a specific feminine person, geographical boundary, or body of instruction/law, often serving as the subject of a verbless identification clause.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent feminine singular pronoun as subject, predicate, or prepositional object referring to a feminine noun or person

senses.definition: Independent pronoun referring abstractly to an action, deed, situation, proclamation, or regulation—either previously stated or immediately following in the discourse.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent pronoun functioning as verbal subject or direct object without a feminine noun antecedent

senses.definition: Independent pronoun governed by a preposition to express means, reason, circumstance, or subsequent time in relation to a preceding or following event.
senses.grammatical_frame: Prepositional phrase (בְּזֹאת, לָזֹאת, עַל זֹאת, אַחֲרֵי זֹאת, בְּכָל זֹאת)

entries.collocations_and_notes: Commonly follows a definite feminine singular noun (with הַ prefixed to both noun and demonstrative: הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת, הָעִיר הַזֹּאת, הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת) or stands alone as a feminine/neuter-like pronoun. Frequent verbal collocations include עָשָׂה זֹאת ("to do this", e.g., GEN 20:6, GEN 44:17, LEV 26:16, 2CH 25:16, ISA 9:6) and interrogative מַה זֹּאת עֲשִׂיתֶם ("what is this you have done?", JDG 2:2). Frequently introduces legal/instructional summaries (זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה, זֹאת חֻקַּת הַתּוֹרָה, וְזֹאת הַמִּצְוָה) and forms prepositional connectors such as בְּזֹאת ("by this"), עַל זֹאת ("concerning/because of this"), בְּכָל זֹאת ("in all this"), and אַחֲרֵי זֹאת ("after this").

entries.core_meaning_summary: The cardinal numeral three (with its plural form thirty), used to quantify items, form higher compound numbers, mark ordinal years, and designate specific numbered military groups.

senses.definition: The basic cardinal quantity three, used both independently and as an element in compound numbers (such as thirteen, twenty-three, three hundred, and three thousand).
senses.grammatical_frame: Numeral preceding or following a noun in apposition (שָׁלֹשׁ, שְׁלֹשָׁה), in construct before plural nouns or larger unit words (שְׁלֹשׁ, שְׁלֹשֶׁת), or with pronominal suffixes (שְׁלָשְׁתְּכֶם, שְׁלֹשְׁתָּם)

senses.definition: Cardinal form functioning ordinally in chronological and regnal date formulas to specify the third or thirteenth year.
senses.grammatical_frame: Numeral in construct chain following שְׁנַת or governed by מִן in date expressions (שְׁנַת שָׁלוֹשׁ; מִן שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה)

senses.definition: The plural-form cardinal numeral thirty, occurring alone, in compound numbers, and in regnal or chronological date formulas.
senses.grammatical_frame: Plural-form numeral (שְׁלֹשִׁים) standing before singular or plural nouns, combined with units or hundreds/thousands, or in construct date phrases (שְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה)

senses.definition: Substantivized definite numeral designating a recognized rank or corps of elite warriors ("the Three" or "the Thirty").
senses.grammatical_frame: Numeral with definite article or in apposition to הַגִּבֹּרִים, governed by prepositions בְּ or עַל

entries.collocations_and_notes: Displays reverse gender agreement in the base cardinal: masculine-marked שְׁלֹשָׁה / שְׁלוֹשָׁה (construct שְׁלֹשֶׁת) pairs with masculine nouns (e.g., שְׁלֹשָׁה בָנִים, שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים, שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים), whereas unmarked שָׁלֹשׁ / שָׁלוֹשׁ (construct שְׁלֹשׁ) pairs with feminine nouns (e.g., שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים, שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת). Suffixed forms take the base שְׁלָשְׁתּ־ / שְׁלֹשְׁתּ־ (שְׁלָשְׁתְּכֶם, שְׁלֹשְׁתָּם). Frequently forms compound numerals with ten (שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, thirteen), hundreds (שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת, three hundred), thousands (שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים, three thousand), and multiples via the plural form שְׁלֹשִׁים (thirty). Appears in the graded numerical sequence עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה ... וְעַל אַרְבָּעָה in AMO 1:6.

entries.core_meaning_summary: Water as a physical liquid substance, encompassing natural bodies and sources, water used for drinking and washing, and figurative expressions of peril, vitality, or instability.

senses.definition: Water forming natural terrestrial, subterranean, or atmospheric bodies, including seas, rivers, floodwaters, springs, pools, cisterns, and rain-clouds.
senses.grammatical_frame: Plural-form noun (absolute מַיִם, construct מֵי, suffixed מֵימ־); subject of verbs of motion/state, object of prepositions (בְּ, עַל, אֶל, לְ), or in construct chains with topographical terms

senses.definition: Potable water drawn, stored, given, or consumed for drinking and physical survival, often paired with bread as a basic necessity.
